questions.title: Mock Examination 1 — Question 1
questions.topic: 大学概念建模
questions.sourceNote: User-provided Questions 1–6 and Question 2 image
questions.question:
Read and analyse the following specification of a sample database domain.

A University would like to create a database to record information about some of its activities. The university offers a number of degrees to students. A degree is described by a unique name, total number of credit points required to complete a degree, and several requirements that must be satisfied by the future students. The university offers three types of degrees: undergraduate degrees, postgraduate degrees, and graduate certificate. Postgraduate degrees are available only for the students who already got an undergraduate degree. A description of a postgraduate degree includes a list of acceptable undergraduate degrees. A description of a graduate certificate includes a requirement on the total number of years of professional experience.

Each degree consists of a collection of subjects. A description of a subject consists of its unique code, unique title, total number of credits points a subject is worth, and a list of subject learning objectives.

The university employs academic staff members, tutors and support staff members. A description of a university employee consists of a unique employee number, first name last name and date of birth. First name, last name and date of birth uniquely identified each employee. Additionally, academic staff members and tutors are described by an academic degree achieved. Support staff members are described by a list of qualifications acquired in the past together with a date when each qualification has been acquired.

The university assigns the academic staff members and tutors to the subjects. A subject has one or two academic members assigned and a number of tutors. An academic staff member and tutor can be assigned to many subjects. Support staff members are assigned to the degrees. Each support staff member is assigned to one degree and a degree has one or more support staff members assigned.

The university is divided into faculties and faculties are divided into schools. Academic staff members and tutors belong to one school and each school consists of many academic staff members and tutors. The faculties and schools are described by the unique names.

Draw a conceptual schema for the specification of a database domain listed above.
questions.answer:
这道题要求画概念图。先确定要描述哪些类，再把属性和关联放入图中。下面的属性表与两张关联图共同构成参考设计。

### 类、属性和identifier

| 类名 | 属性及标识规则 |
| --- | --- |
| DEGREE | 学位名称唯一；另记录所需总学分和若干入学要求 |
| UNDERGRADUATE_DEGREE | 继承 DEGREE 的属性 |
| POSTGRADUATE_DEGREE | 继承 DEGREE；用关联记录接受的本科学位 |
| GRADUATE_CERTIFICATE | 继承 DEGREE；另记录所需专业工作年数 |
| SUBJECT | 科目代码、科目名称分别唯一；另记录学分和学习目标列表 |
| EMPLOYEE | 员工号唯一；“名、姓、出生日期”的组合也是一个独立identifier |
| ACADEMIC_STAFF | 继承 EMPLOYEE；另记录已取得的学位 |
| TUTOR | 继承 EMPLOYEE；另记录已取得的学位 |
| SUPPORT_STAFF | 继承 EMPLOYEE；逐项记录资格名称及该资格的获得日期 |
| FACULTY | 学院名称唯一 |
| SCHOOL | 学系名称唯一 |

同一员工的一项资格及其日期需要配成一组。不能把全部资格、全部日期分别存成两个互不对应的列表。

### 学位和科目之间的关联

```mermaid
classDiagram
    direction LR
    DEGREE <|-- UNDERGRADUATE_DEGREE
    DEGREE <|-- POSTGRADUATE_DEGREE
    DEGREE <|-- GRADUATE_CERTIFICATE
    DEGREE "0..*" -- "1..*" SUBJECT : consists_of
    POSTGRADUATE_DEGREE "0..*" -- "1..*" UNDERGRADUATE_DEGREE : accepts
```

一个学位包含一组科目；本参考图允许一个科目用于多个学位。研究生学位与可接受的本科学位之间建立关联。

### 员工、组织和工作分配之间的关联

```mermaid
classDiagram
    direction LR
    EMPLOYEE <|-- ACADEMIC_STAFF
    EMPLOYEE <|-- TUTOR
    EMPLOYEE <|-- SUPPORT_STAFF
    FACULTY "1" -- "1..*" SCHOOL : contains
    SCHOOL "1" -- "1..*" ACADEMIC_STAFF : has
    SCHOOL "1" -- "1..*" TUTOR : has
    ACADEMIC_STAFF "1..2" -- "0..*" SUBJECT : assigned_to
    TUTOR "1..*" -- "0..*" SUBJECT : assigned_to
    SUPPORT_STAFF "1..*" -- "1" DEGREE : assigned_to
```

每个学系属于一个学院；每位学术人员、辅导教师属于一个学系。每个科目分配一至两名学术人员。支持人员与学位之间，支持人员一方只能对应一个学位，学位一方至少对应一名支持人员。

### 本参考图采用的假设

- 将三种学位理解为互不重叠、覆盖全部学位的分类；原题没有明确员工身份能否重叠，故不额外声明员工子类互斥。
- 对“若干辅导教师”和学系中的“多名人员”，图中采用至少一名的下限。若课程允许暂未配人，下限需相应改成 0，并写明解释。
- 对题目没有强制下限的反方向，图中允许暂时没有分配。例如一名学术人员可以暂未负责科目。这是图中采用的解释，不是原文明确给出的最低数。
- 员工已取得的学位、研究生项目接受的本科资格，可能来自校外。本设计不能因只记录本校开设的学位而排除这种资格。

parts.goal: 从大学业务说明生成完整conceptual schema
steps: 先分对象种类：Degree、Subject、Employee、Faculty、School；再分Degree的三个子类、Employee的三个子类。不要因为文字提到学生，就新增没有描述要求的Student类。
逐项读唯一性：Subject的code与title分别唯一；Employee除employee_number外，还有(first_name,last_name,date_of_birth)这个组合identifier。把三个姓名/日期属性标成同一个ID标签。
把requirements、learning objectives表示为multivalued attributes；支持人员的qualification和acquired_date要成对，避免两个列表无法一一对应。
每条association分别向两个方向读：一门科目有1–2名academic staff；一位academic staff可负责多门。Support staff恰属于一个Degree，Degree至少对应一位Support staff。
将已确定的attributes、identifiers、multiplicities填进类框和关联线。a number of等未给精确下限的措辞，采用假设时单独标明，不把假设写成题面事实。
parts.check: 图中必须既有属性，也有连接和数量；code、title两种独立identifier与员工三项组合identifier没有混淆。
parts.pitfall: 不要用关系表的foreign keys代替conceptual association，也不要把员工已获学位限制为必须来自本校。

questions.topic: 运输服务逻辑设计
questions.sourceNote: User-provided Questions 1–6 and Question 2 image
questions.question:
Consider a conceptual schema given below.

![Original conceptual schema](assets/mock-1-q2.jpg)

Your task is to perform a step of logical database design, i.e. to transform a conceptual schema given above into a collection of relational schemas.

For each relational schema clearly list the names of attributes, primary key, candidate keys (if any), and foreign keys (if any). Assume, that a superset method must be used to implement a generalization.
questions.answer:
下面逐表列出relational schema。PK 表示primary key；Other CK 表示未选作primary key的其他candidate key；FK 表示foreign key。primary key本身也属于candidate key。

foreign key能保证被引用对象存在，但不能单独保证“每项服务至少有一位司机”。这个最低数量要求需要另外维护。

### 先识别服务的复合identifier

TSERVICE 的三个属性使用同一个 ID 标签，表示它们共同识别一项服务，而不是各自唯一。

```text
(departure_city, destination_city, departure_time)
```

### BUS：巴士

每辆巴士由 rego 唯一识别。

```text
BUS(rego, make)
PRIMARY KEY = (rego)
OTHER CANDIDATE KEYS = none
FOREIGN KEY1 = none
```

### DRIVER：司机

dlnumber 和 enumber 是两个分别唯一的identifier。本答案选择驾照号作primary key，员工号作另一个candidate key。

```text
DRIVER(dlnumber, enumber, full_name)
PRIMARY KEY = (dlnumber)
CANDIDATE KEY1 = (enumber)
FOREIGN KEY1 = none
```

### TSERVICE：把父类和子类合成一张表

按照 superset method，把共有属性和两个子类的专有属性放在同一表。用 service_type 记录类别。较长服务填写 total_days，较短服务填写 total_hours。这里假设每项服务只属于一种类型。每项服务使用一辆巴士，因此 rego 是非空foreign key。

```text
TSERVICE(
    departure_city,
    destination_city,
    departure_time,
    arrival_time,
    rego,
    service_type,
    total_days,
    total_hours
)

PRIMARY KEY = (departure_city, destination_city, departure_time)
OTHER CANDIDATE KEYS = none
FOREIGN KEY1 = (rego) REFERENCES BUS(rego)
```

### SERVICE_DRIVER：记录服务与司机的分配

一项服务可有多名司机，一名司机可负责多项服务，因此每一对“服务—司机”单独记录。表中的primary key包含完整服务identifier和司机identifier。

```text
SERVICE_DRIVER(
    departure_city,
    destination_city,
    departure_time,
    dlnumber
)

PRIMARY KEY = (departure_city, destination_city, departure_time, dlnumber)
OTHER CANDIDATE KEYS = none
FOREIGN KEY1 = (departure_city, destination_city, departure_time)
     REFERENCES TSERVICE(departure_city, destination_city, departure_time)
FOREIGN KEY2 = (dlnumber) REFERENCES DRIVER(dlnumber)
```

### STOP：记录同一服务下的停靠点

snumber 是qualifier。图中的 0..1 表示：固定一项服务和一个 snumber，至多对应一个停靠点；不表示整项服务最多只能有一个停靠点。停靠点的primary key是完整服务identifier加 snumber。带 service_ 前缀的时间属于服务，不带该前缀的时间属于停靠点。

```text
STOP(
    service_departure_city,
    service_destination_city,
    service_departure_time,
    snumber,
    stop_city,
    departure_time,
    arrival_time
)

PRIMARY KEY = (
    service_departure_city,
    service_destination_city,
    service_departure_time,
    snumber
)
OTHER CANDIDATE KEYS = none
FOREIGN KEY1 = (service_departure_city, service_destination_city, service_departure_time)
    REFERENCES TSERVICE(departure_city, destination_city, departure_time)
```

### 图中标签对照

**图中文字对照（仅翻译，不作转换提示）**：LONGER TSERVICE 较长运输服务；SHORTER TSERVICE 较短运输服务；TSERVICE 运输服务；BUS 巴士；DRIVER 司机；STOP 停靠点。total-days 总天数；total-hours 总小时数；rego 注册号；make 品牌；departure-city 出发城市；destination-city 目的城市；departure-time 出发时间；arrival time/arrival-time 到达时间；dlnumber 驾照号；enumber 员工号；full-name 全名；snumber 停靠序号。Assigned-to 分配给；Passes-through 途经。ID identifier；ID1、ID2 为不同identifier；1 恰好一个；* 多个（可为零）；1..* 一个或多个；0..1 零个或一个。三角空心箭头为 generalization（泛化）符号。

parts.goal: 按superset method把运输服务图转换成relational schemas
steps: TSERVICE的三个ID属性合起来才识别一项服务；先抄完整组合(departure_city,destination_city,departure_time)，后续所有引用都使用这三项。
先建立不引用其他表的BUS与DRIVER。DRIVER的dlnumber、enumber分别唯一：选其中一个为primary key，另一个保留为candidate key。
把较长与较短服务合入TSERVICE，增加service_type。total_days与total_hours是子类专有属性，在整表需要允许NULL，并按类别填写。
BUS到TSERVICE是一对多，把rego放入TSERVICE作foreign key；TSERVICE到DRIVER是many-to-many，建立SERVICE_DRIVER保存完整配对。
STOP受服务和snumber共同限定，所以primary key是服务三项标识再加snumber；STOP本身的到离时间与服务时间要区分命名。
用课堂PRIMARY KEY =、CANDIDATE KEY =、FOREIGN KEY = ... REFERENCES ...格式列出，父表先于子表。检查minimum participation不能仅靠foreign key保证的限制。
parts.check: 最终有BUS、DRIVER、TSERVICE、SERVICE_DRIVER、STOP五个schemas；STOP每个key含4项。
parts.pitfall: 0..1针对固定(service,snumber)，不是整项服务最多一个STOP。

questions.title: Mock Examination 1 — Question 3
questions.topic: 运输数据库：SELECT 查询
questions.sourceNote: User-provided Questions 1–6 and Question 2 image
questions.question:
Write SELECT statements that implement the following queries.

(1) Find the registration numbers of trucks, that have capacity in a range between 100 inclusive and 500 inclusive.

(2) Find the first and the last names of all drivers who are on leave.

(3) Find the registration numbers of all trucks that have not been used for any trips.

(4) Find the registration numbers of all trucks together with total number of trips the trucks have been used for. There is no need to include the truck that have not been used for any trips.

(5) Find the names of all departure cities together with the names of all destination cities.
questions.answer:
### (1) 容量从100到500，包含两端

BETWEEN 包含两个边界。原建表语句同时规定 CAPACITY 小于100；如果该 CHECK 生效，合法数据中不会有符合本查询的行。这里按查询要求写语句，并保留原题的约束冲突。

```sql
SELECT REGNUM
FROM TRUCK
WHERE CAPACITY BETWEEN 100 AND 500;
```

### (2) 休假司机的名和姓

姓名在 EMPLOYEE，司机状态在 DRIVER。通过员工号 ENUM 连接，再筛选 ON LEAVE。不同司机可能同名，所以不能仅因姓名相同就去重。

```sql
SELECT E.FNAME, E.LNAME
FROM EMPLOYEE AS E
JOIN DRIVER AS D
    ON D.ENUM = E.ENUM
WHERE D.STATUS = 'ON LEAVE';
```

### (3) 从未用于行程的卡车

对每辆卡车，检查 TRIP 中是否不存在引用它的行程记录。当前车辆状态不能代替历史行程记录。

```sql
SELECT T.REGNUM
FROM TRUCK AS T
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM TRIP AS P
    WHERE P.REGNUM = T.REGNUM
);
```

### (4) 每辆已使用卡车的行程总数

TRIP 每行代表一次行程。按卡车注册号分组后计数即可，未使用的卡车自然不会出现。连接 TRIPLEG 后直接计数可能会数成路段数。

```sql
SELECT REGNUM, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_TRIPS
FROM TRIP
GROUP BY REGNUM;
```

### (5) 解释一：合成一列城市名单

如果原句要求把出发城市和目的城市合成一个名单，用 UNION，并去除重复名称。

```sql
SELECT DEPARTURE AS CITY
FROM TRIPLEG
UNION
SELECT DESTINATION AS CITY
FROM TRIPLEG;
```

### (5) 解释二：列出出发地和目的地的配对

如果老师要求的是两列“出发城市—目的城市”配对，用下面这条查询。原句没有明确结果形状；两条查询回答的含义不同，不能当成可互换的答案。

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTURE, DESTINATION
FROM TRIPLEG;
```

parts.goal: 返回容量区间内卡车的注册号
steps: 输出只有注册号REGNUM，数据来自TRUCK，不需要连接其他表。
inclusive要求100、500都包含，使用CAPACITY BETWEEN 100 AND 500。
核对CREATE TABLE中的CAPACITY CHECK；若小于100的约束生效，此查询合法但没有匹配行。
parts.check: WHERE条件包含两个边界；有空结果时先核对约束，不修改题目数值。
parts.pitfall: 不要把CAPACITY换成WEIGHT来“修复”原题冲突。
parts.code:
```sql
SELECT REGNUM
FROM TRUCK
WHERE CAPACITY BETWEEN 100 AND 500;
```

parts.goal: 返回休假司机的名和姓
steps: 姓名在EMPLOYEE，状态在DRIVER，确定两表通过ENUM匹配。
JOIN后筛选D.STATUS = 'ON LEAVE'，而不是筛选员工表中不存在的状态。
SELECT只列FNAME、LNAME。不同司机可同名，题目没有要求按姓名去重。
parts.check: 每个符合状态的司机贡献一行姓名。
parts.pitfall: 只查DRIVER得不到姓名，随意DISTINCT又可能合并不同司机。
parts.code:
```sql
SELECT E.FNAME, E.LNAME
FROM EMPLOYEE AS E
JOIN DRIVER AS D
    ON D.ENUM = E.ENUM
WHERE D.STATUS = 'ON LEAVE';
```

parts.goal: 返回从未执行行程的卡车
steps: 从TRUCK开始，才能包含没有任何TRIP的卡车。
对当前卡车匹配TRIP.REGNUM = TRUCK.REGNUM。
用NOT EXISTS保留完全没有匹配行程的卡车；车辆当前状态不代表历史是否使用过。
parts.check: 没有行程的卡车必须保留；有一次或更多行程的必须排除。
parts.pitfall: WHERE状态AVAILABLE不能回答“从未使用”。
parts.code:
```sql
SELECT T.REGNUM
FROM TRUCK AS T
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM TRIP AS P
    WHERE P.REGNUM = T.REGNUM
);
```

parts.goal: 按已使用卡车统计行程次数
steps: TRIP中的一行是一趟行程，正是要计数的对象。
按REGNUM分组，用COUNT(*)统计每组行数。
直接从TRIP出发即可自动排除没有行程的卡车，不需要额外outer join。
parts.check: 同一注册号只出一行；计数是trip数而不是leg数。
parts.pitfall: 连接TRIPLEG会把一趟多段行程放大成多行。
parts.code:
```sql
SELECT REGNUM, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_TRIPS
FROM TRIP
GROUP BY REGNUM;
```

parts.goal: 明确城市查询的结果形状，再选择SQL
steps: 先区分两种可能：一列“所有城市名称”，或者两列“出发城市—目的城市配对”。原句未明确这一点。
若要求合成一列名单，分别SELECT DEPARTURE、DESTINATION，用UNION合并去重。
若要求配对，则SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTURE, DESTINATION，保留同一条路段上的配对关系。
parts.check: 核对输出列数以及是否保留城市配对；两种答案不能称为含义相同。
parts.pitfall: 不要不说明结果形状就把两条SQL当作完全可互换的写法。
parts.code:
```sql
SELECT DEPARTURE AS CITY
FROM TRIPLEG
UNION
SELECT DESTINATION AS CITY
FROM TRIPLEG;
```

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTURE, DESTINATION
FROM TRIPLEG;
```

questions.title: Mock Examination 1 — Question 4
questions.topic: 司机技能与行程记录的修改
questions.sourceNote: User-provided Questions 1–6 and Question 2 image
questions.question:
Write SQL statements that implement the following structural modifications of a database and data manipulations on the contents of a database. Note, that implementation of some of the tasks listed below may need more than one SQL statement.

(1) We would like to add to a database information about the skills possessed by each driver. Assume, that a driver has many skills and a skill can be possessed by many drivers. It may happen that some skills are not possessed by any driver. The types of the new columns are up to you.

(2) Delete from a database information about the second and third leg of a trip 36.

(3) Change a date of trip number 26 to the next day after the present date of trip 26.

(4) Assume that a trip number 25 has 3 legs. A trip number 25 started in Sydney and it ended in Perth. Add one more leg to a trip 25 such that after update the trip ends in the same city it started from.

(5) Assume that a trip 20 has 2 legs and that a destination of the first leg is Sydney. Update information about a trip 20 such that after update a destination of the first leg is Perth.
questions.answer:
以下数据修改还必须满足已有唯一性约束。例如，改变行程日期后若造成 (LNUM, REGNUM, TDATE) 重复，更新会被拒绝。

### (1) 记录技能及司机拥有的技能

SKILL 保存技能本身。DRIVER_SKILL 每行表示一名司机拥有一项技能。这样，没有司机具备的技能仍可保存在 SKILL 中。composite primary key防止同一配对重复；这些键不自动保证每名司机至少拥有一项技能。

```sql
CREATE TABLE SKILL (
    SKILL_CODE VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    SKILL_NAME VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT SKILL_PKEY PRIMARY KEY (SKILL_CODE)
);

CREATE TABLE DRIVER_SKILL (
    ENUM DECIMAL(12) NOT NULL,
    SKILL_CODE VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT DRIVER_SKILL_PKEY PRIMARY KEY (ENUM, SKILL_CODE),
    CONSTRAINT DRIVER_SKILL_DRIVER_FKEY
        FOREIGN KEY (ENUM) REFERENCES DRIVER (ENUM),
    CONSTRAINT DRIVER_SKILL_SKILL_FKEY
        FOREIGN KEY (SKILL_CODE) REFERENCES SKILL (SKILL_CODE)
);
```

### (2) 删除行程36的第2、3段

同时限制 TNUM 和 LEGNUM，只删除这次行程的两个指定路段。

```sql
DELETE FROM TRIPLEG
WHERE TNUM = 36
  AND LEGNUM IN (2, 3);
```

### (3) 行程26的已存日期加一天

起点是该行程当前保存在 TDATE 中的日期，而不是今天。

```sql
UPDATE TRIP
SET TDATE = DATE_ADD(TDATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
WHERE TNUM = 26;
```

### (4) 为行程25增加返回路段

已有三段，因此新增第四段。从原终点 Perth 出发，回到原起点 Sydney。

```sql
INSERT INTO TRIPLEG (TNUM, LEGNUM, DEPARTURE, DESTINATION)
VALUES (25, 4, 'Perth', 'Sydney');
```

### (5) 修改行程20第一段的目的地

下面第一条 UPDATE 直接完成题面明确要求。第二条 UPDATE 采用额外的业务假设：相邻路段必须首尾相接，所以也把第二段起点改为 Perth。题目给出的表约束没有强制这条连续性；只按题面最低要求作答时，不应把第二条当成原文明确要求。

```sql
UPDATE TRIPLEG
SET DESTINATION = 'Perth'
WHERE TNUM = 20
  AND LEGNUM = 1;

UPDATE TRIPLEG
SET DEPARTURE = 'Perth'
WHERE TNUM = 20
  AND LEGNUM = 2;
```

parts.goal: 用结构表达司机与技能的many-to-many关系
steps: 技能可能没有任何司机拥有，因此SKILL必须能独立存一行。
DRIVER_SKILL每行保存一个司机与技能配对，两个foreign keys分别引用DRIVER和SKILL。
把(ENUM,SKILL_CODE)作为composite primary key，防止重复拥有关系。若还要求每司机至少一项技能，说明这不是普通foreign key自动保证的。
parts.check: 可以只插入SKILL而没有DRIVER_SKILL；配对的两端必须真实存在。
parts.pitfall: 不要把多个技能用逗号塞进DRIVER的一列，也不要只建配对表而丢失无人拥有的技能。
parts.code:
```sql
CREATE TABLE SKILL (
    SKILL_CODE VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    SKILL_NAME VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT SKILL_PKEY PRIMARY KEY (SKILL_CODE)
);

CREATE TABLE DRIVER_SKILL (
    ENUM DECIMAL(12) NOT NULL,
    SKILL_CODE VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT DRIVER_SKILL_PKEY PRIMARY KEY (ENUM, SKILL_CODE),
    CONSTRAINT DRIVER_SKILL_DRIVER_FKEY
        FOREIGN KEY (ENUM) REFERENCES DRIVER (ENUM),
    CONSTRAINT DRIVER_SKILL_SKILL_FKEY
        FOREIGN KEY (SKILL_CODE) REFERENCES SKILL (SKILL_CODE)
);
```

parts.goal: 只删除行程36的第2、3段
steps: 操作对象是TRIPLEG中的行，不是TRIP整行。
TNUM = 36限定行程，LEGNUM IN (2,3)限定两个路段。
DELETE前可用相同WHERE写SELECT检查命中范围；正式答案保留必要DELETE即可。
parts.check: 其他行程的第2、3段、行程36的其他路段均保留。
parts.pitfall: 漏掉TNUM会误删所有行程的这些路段。
parts.code:
```sql
DELETE FROM TRIPLEG
WHERE TNUM = 36
  AND LEGNUM IN (2, 3);
```

parts.goal: 给行程26当前日期加一天
steps: WHERE TNUM=26确定唯一要更新的行。
题目说present date of trip 26，基准是已存TDATE。
SET TDATE=DATE_ADD(TDATE,INTERVAL 1 DAY)处理跨月、跨年；检查更新后不会违反既有UNIQUE组合。
parts.check: 原日期若为月末或年末，结果仍是正确下一天。
parts.pitfall: CURRENT_DATE()+1用今天作起点，与题意不同。
parts.code:
```sql
UPDATE TRIP
SET TDATE = DATE_ADD(TDATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
WHERE TNUM = 26;
```

parts.goal: 为行程25增加第四段返回路程
steps: 原有三段，新路段LEGNUM应为4。
原终点Perth成为新路段起点，原起点Sydney成为新路段终点。
向TRIPLEG插入(25,4,Perth,Sydney)，TRIP记录必须已存在。
parts.check: 新增后最后一个目的地为Sydney，且与前一段终点接续。
parts.pitfall: 不要把新增路段写成Sydney到Perth，或覆盖现有第三段。
parts.code:
```sql
INSERT INTO TRIPLEG (TNUM, LEGNUM, DEPARTURE, DESTINATION)
VALUES (25, 4, 'Perth', 'Sydney');
```

parts.goal: 把行程20第一段目的地改成Perth
steps: 直接要求由TNUM=20且LEGNUM=1定位。
第一条UPDATE只修改DESTINATION，直接完成题面要求。
若额外采用“相邻路段必须首尾相接”的业务规则，再同步更新第二段DEPARTURE，并在同一transaction处理；这条规则不是原DDL强制的。
parts.check: 明确区分最低题面要求与额外连续性假设；检查UNIQUE仍满足。
parts.pitfall: 不要无说明地把修改第二段也宣称为题目明确要求。
parts.code:
```sql
UPDATE TRIPLEG
SET DESTINATION = 'Perth'
WHERE TNUM = 20
  AND LEGNUM = 1;

UPDATE TRIPLEG
SET DEPARTURE = 'Perth'
WHERE TNUM = 20
  AND LEGNUM = 2;
```

questions.title: Mock Examination 1 — Question 5
questions.topic: USER_A / USER_B 用户与权限
questions.sourceNote: User-provided Questions 1–6 and Question 2 image Public edition: example names, contact details and password literals anonymized.
questions.question:
Assume that a user root with a password '[ROOT_OR_USER_PASSWORD]' created a database called transport and the user executed CREATE TABLE statements given on page 2 of the examination paper to create the relational tables in the database transport.

Write the implementations of the operations listed below as a user root. Assume that a user root has already connected to the database. Note, that implementation of some operations may need more than one SQL statement.

(1) A user root nominates a database transport as a default database and then the user creates two new users USER_A and USER_B.

(2) A user root grants the read access rights to the relational tables EMPLOYEE and DRIVER to a user USER_A. The read access rights cannot be propagated to other roles or users.

(3) A user root grants the rights to insert the rows into a relational tables TRIP and TRIPLEG to a user USER_B. The access rights can be propagated to other roles or users.

(4) A user root grants the update privilege on all relational tables in csit115 database to a user USER_A. The privilege cannot be propagated to other roles or users.

(5) A user root grants the rights to information about the total number trips performed by each driver to a user USER_B.
questions.answer:
### (1) 选定数据库并创建用户

root 已经连接，无需再次登录。这里统一使用 localhost 账号。题目没有指定 USER_A、USER_B 的密码，因此示例没有把 root 的密码当成他们的密码。

```sql
USE transport;

CREATE USER 'USER_A'@'localhost';
CREATE USER 'USER_B'@'localhost';
```

### (2) 授予TRAINER_01两张表的读取权限

读取对应 SELECT。对于题中刚创建、没有其他授权来源的账号，不加 WITH GRANT OPTION，表示没有授予转授权能力。

```sql
GRANT SELECT ON transport.EMPLOYEE
TO 'USER_A'@'localhost';

GRANT SELECT ON transport.DRIVER
TO 'USER_A'@'localhost';
```

### (3) 授予USER_B插入权限，并允许转授权

INSERT 是插入行的权限。WITH GRANT OPTION 允许 USER_B 把相应权限再授给其他用户或角色。

```sql
GRANT INSERT ON transport.TRIP
TO 'USER_B'@'localhost'
WITH GRANT OPTION;

GRANT INSERT ON transport.TRIPLEG
TO 'USER_B'@'localhost'
WITH GRANT OPTION;
```

### (4) 授予TRAINER_01更新csit115中所有表的权限

原题此处写的是 csit115，不是 transport。答案保留这个数据库名；不能把怀疑的笔误直接改成另一数据库。

```sql
GRANT UPDATE ON csit115.*
TO 'USER_A'@'localhost';
```

### (5) 让USER_B读取每位司机的行程总数

先建立汇总视图，再只向 USER_B 授予该视图的 SELECT。LEFT JOIN保留没有行程的司机；COUNT(T.TNUM) 使他们得到0。视图由 root 创建，使用 SQL SECURITY DEFINER，因此无需另外授予 USER_B 底表的直接读取权限。

```sql
CREATE SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW transport.DRIVER_TRIP_TOTAL AS
SELECT D.ENUM,
       D.LNUM,
       COUNT(T.TNUM) AS TOTAL_TRIPS
FROM transport.DRIVER AS D
LEFT JOIN transport.TRIP AS T
    ON T.LNUM = D.LNUM
GROUP BY D.ENUM, D.LNUM;

GRANT SELECT ON transport.DRIVER_TRIP_TOTAL
TO 'USER_B'@'localhost';
```

parts.goal: 设定默认数据库并创建两名用户
steps: root已连接，直接USE transport，无需再次写登录命令。
统一约定TRAINER_01、USER_B为localhost账号，避免后续GRANT引用不同host。
CREATE USER各执行一次；题目只给了root密码，不把它自动分配给新用户。
parts.check: USE先于依赖默认数据库的操作；新用户名称/host前后一致。
parts.pitfall: 数据库用户名root与操作系统root不是一回事。

parts.goal: 授予TRAINER_01读取两表且不可转授
steps: 读取表的操作权限是SELECT。
分别对transport.EMPLOYEE、transport.DRIVER授权。
对于新建且没有其他权限来源的TRAINER_01，不带WITH GRANT OPTION。
parts.check: 只读范围包含两表，未增加INSERT或UPDATE。
parts.pitfall: 省略GRANT OPTION仅在没有其他传播权限来源时满足不可转授，不能普遍忽略旧授权。

parts.goal: 授予USER_B插入两表并允许转授
steps: 插入行使用INSERT privilege，不需要授全部权限。
分别定位transport.TRIP、transport.TRIPLEG。
每条GRANT加WITH GRANT OPTION，允许继续授予相同范围权限。
parts.check: 两个目标表都有INSERT及转授权能力。
parts.pitfall: WITH ADMIN OPTION针对role成员资格，不替代对象的GRANT OPTION。
parts.code:
```sql
GRANT INSERT ON transport.TRIP
TO 'USER_B'@'localhost'
WITH GRANT OPTION;

GRANT INSERT ON transport.TRIPLEG
TO 'USER_B'@'localhost'
WITH GRANT OPTION;
```

parts.goal: 授予TRAINER_01数据库范围的UPDATE
steps: 原文写csit115数据库，保留这个名字，不擅自换成transport。
ON csit115.*表示该数据库内所有表。
只授UPDATE，且不增加WITH GRANT OPTION。
parts.check: 权限范围是数据库，不是全服务器*.*。
parts.pitfall: 把root的密码csit115与本小题数据库名混为一个概念会读错范围。
parts.code:
```sql
GRANT UPDATE ON csit115.*
TO 'USER_A'@'localhost';
```

parts.goal: 通过view开放司机行程总数
steps: 从DRIVER左连接TRIP，才能保留零行程司机。
按司机的ENUM、LNUM分组，COUNT(T.TNUM)让未匹配者得到0。
由root创建SQL SECURITY DEFINER view，再只授USER_B该view的SELECT。
parts.check: 零次司机为0；USER_B不必取得底表直接读取权。
parts.pitfall: COUNT(*)会把outer join补出的行也算成1。
parts.code:
```sql
CREATE SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW transport.DRIVER_TRIP_TOTAL AS
SELECT D.ENUM,
       D.LNUM,
       COUNT(T.TNUM) AS TOTAL_TRIPS
FROM transport.DRIVER AS D
LEFT JOIN transport.TRIP AS T
    ON T.LNUM = D.LNUM
GROUP BY D.ENUM, D.LNUM;

GRANT SELECT ON transport.DRIVER_TRIP_TOTAL
TO 'USER_B'@'localhost';
```

questions.title: Mock Examination 1 — Question 6
questions.topic: 查找行程次数超过100的卡车
questions.sourceNote: User-provided Questions 1–6 and Question 2 image
questions.question:
Assume, that we would like to verify the following logical consistency constraint imposed on the contents of a sample database.

"A truck cannot be used for more that 100 trips"

Write SQL statements that perform the following actions.

(1) First, create a relational table MESSAGE with information about the contents of a sample database that violate the following consistency constraint listed above. A relational table MESSAGE must consist of two columns. The first column contains truck registration numbers and the second column contains the total number of trips for all trucks that have been used for more than 100 trips.

(2) Next, list the contents of a relational table MESSAGE in the following way.

Truck <insert ruck registration number here> has been used for <insert total number of trips here> trips.

For example, if a truck with registration number PKR856 has been used 120 times then the following line must be listed.

Truck PKR856 has been used for 120 trips.

(3) Next, make the contents of a relational table MESSAGE permanent.

(4) Finally, drop a relational table MESSAGE.
questions.answer:
### (1) 创建两列的MESSAGE表

按注册号统计行程，用 HAVING 保留次数大于100的卡车。恰好100次不违反题目规则。

```sql
CREATE TABLE MESSAGE AS
SELECT REGNUM, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_TRIPS
FROM TRIP
GROUP BY REGNUM
HAVING COUNT(*) > 100;
```

### (2) 拼出要求的英文句子

CONCAT 把固定文字、注册号和次数连接成一个字符串。

```sql
SELECT CONCAT(
           'Truck ', REGNUM,
           ' has been used for ', TOTAL_TRIPS,
           ' trips.'
       ) AS MESSAGE_TEXT
FROM MESSAGE;
```

### 输出格式示例

这里展示的是题目给定的示例，不是编造数据库实际查询结果。

```text
Truck PKR856 has been used for 120 trips.
```

### (3) 提交修改

题目的“永久保存”对应 COMMIT。MySQL 中普通 CREATE TABLE ... AS SELECT 已可能发生隐式提交，因此这一步不一定还有待提交内容；仍按题目步骤列出 COMMIT。

```sql
COMMIT;
```

### (4) 删除MESSAGE表

DROP TABLE 删除表及数据。先前 COMMIT 不会阻止之后删表。MESSAGE 是创建时的检查结果，不会自动随以后行程记录变化。

```sql
DROP TABLE MESSAGE;
```

parts.goal: 创建只包含违规卡车的两列快照表
steps: 按TRIP.REGNUM分组，对行程计数，不连接路段表。
HAVING COUNT(*)>100筛选违规组，100恰好不违规。
CREATE TABLE MESSAGE AS SELECT只选REGNUM和次数别名，保持两列。
parts.check: 表结构恰好两列；满足规则的卡车不在MESSAGE中。
parts.pitfall: WHERE不能直接筛选分组后的COUNT，>=100又会多报边界。
parts.code:
```sql
CREATE TABLE MESSAGE AS
SELECT REGNUM, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_TRIPS
FROM TRIP
GROUP BY REGNUM
HAVING COUNT(*) > 100;
```

parts.goal: 按要求构造一列英文消息
steps: 从已经建立的MESSAGE读REGNUM与TOTAL_TRIPS。
CONCAT拼接固定文字、注册号和次数。
保留空格和末尾句号，使输出与题目示例一致。
parts.check: 示例应为Truck PKR856 has been used for 120 trips.。
parts.pitfall: 不是SELECT三个分开的列，也不需要修改数据库里的注册号。
parts.code:
```sql
SELECT CONCAT(
           'Truck ', REGNUM,
           ' has been used for ', TOTAL_TRIPS,
           ' trips.'
       ) AS MESSAGE_TEXT
FROM MESSAGE;
```

parts.goal: 提交未提交修改
steps: make permanent在事务题中对应COMMIT。
按题目顺序在检查输出之后列出COMMIT。
说明MySQL普通CTAS有隐式提交，不能把此COMMIT描述成它首次永久建表的唯一条件。
parts.check: 知道题面操作与MySQL implicit commit的区别。
parts.pitfall: 把所有DDL都当成可以由后续ROLLBACK恢复会产生错误。

parts.goal: 最后删除MESSAGE表
steps: 删除整个临时报告结构用DROP TABLE MESSAGE。
这与DELETE全部行不同，后者还保留定义。
之前COMMIT不阻止之后执行DROP；MESSAGE也不会自动追踪后续TRIP改变。
parts.check: DROP完成后表不存在，而不只是表内变空。
parts.pitfall: 把“永久保存”理解成表以后无法删除。

questions.question:
Read and analyse the following specification of a sample database domain.

A description of a hospital consists of a unique hospital name, address of a main building including city, street, and building number, phone and fax numbers, and email address. The phone number, fax number, and email address can also be used for the identification purposes. A hospital consists of a number of buildings. A building number is a local identifier of a building. Some of the buildings have the names, which are unique within a hospital.

A hospital consists of wards and wards consist of decks. Each ward has a unique name and is located in one building. A ward may occupy several levels of a building. A deck is identified by a number unique within a ward and it is located at one level of a building. The database should contain the complete information about the locations of buildings and decks.

A hospital employs the doctors, nurses, administration and maintenance staff members. The employees are described by an employee number unique within a hospital, first name, last name, date of birth and salary. The doctors are additional described by a status and specialization. The nurses are also described by a category. Administration and maintenance staff members are described by a position occupied. The doctors are assigned to the wards and the nurses are assigned to the decks. Additionally, a hospital contracts a number of consultants. The consultants are not assigned to the wards and are employed by a hospital for a limited time only. The consultants are described by first and last name, specialization, phone number, and amount of charge per hour, start and end of contract with a hospital. The consultants can be employed by more than one hospital at a time.

A hospital admits the patients for the treatments. A patient is described by medical insurance company name and insurance policy number. Date and time are recorded on admittance to a hospital. A patient may be admitted to and discharged from a hospital many times. On arrival to a hospital a patient passes through entry physical examinations, which consists of a number of tests. The database should contain information about the names of tests applied and the results of the tests conducted just after arrival to a hospital. When, an illness a patient suffers from is identified he/she is located at a ward and at a deck of a ward.

Design a conceptual schema for the database domain described above. Use a notation of simplified UML object class diagrams explained during the lecture classes and applied for conceptual modelling in the assignments and class test. Remember to determine the multiplicities of associations, identifiers of classes of objects, multivalued, optional and derived attributes (if any).

There is NO NEED to provide a detailed analysis how a conceptual schema has been created. The final conceptual schema expressed in a notation of UML simplified classes is completely sufficient.

It is not allowed to use any artificial identifiers and any attributes that are not mentioned in a specification above.
questions.answer:
本题禁止新增人工编号和题外属性。局部号码要结合所属对象识别，不能当作全数据库唯一号码。

### 先说明原题没有交代清楚的标识问题

原题没有明确指定顾问的唯一属性。本参考设计假设“每位顾问的电话唯一且不共享”，用 phone 识别顾问。若不接受这个假设，原题不足以确定顾问的可靠identifier，不能擅自添加 consultant_id。

还假设：同一顾问与同一医院不会有两份开始时间相同的合同；同一病人在同一医院同一日期和时刻不会产生两次入院。这些是本答案使用现有属性确定自然标识的假设。

### 类、属性和标识方式

| 类 | 应记录的信息 | 标识方式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HOSPITAL | 名称、电话、传真、邮箱；主楼地址可由主楼关联取得 | 医院名称、电话、传真、邮箱分别可识别医院 |
| BUILDING | 建筑编号、可选名称、城市、街道 | 所属医院+建筑编号；有名称时，所属医院+建筑名称也可识别 |
| WARD | 病区名称、占用的楼层列表 | 病区名称；按原文未加局部限定的“唯一名称”理解 |
| DECK | 分区编号、所在楼层 | 所属病区+分区编号 |
| EMPLOYEE | 员工号、名、姓、出生日期、薪水 | 所属医院+员工号 |
| DOCTOR | 继承员工属性；增加状态和专业方向 | 继承员工标识 |
| NURSE | 继承员工属性；增加类别 | 继承员工标识 |
| ADMINISTRATION_STAFF | 继承员工属性；增加职位 | 继承员工标识 |
| MAINTENANCE_STAFF | 继承员工属性；增加职位 | 继承员工标识 |
| CONSULTANT | 名、姓、专业方向、电话 | phone，仅在上面的电话唯一假设下成立 |
| CONTRACT | 开始时间、结束时间、每小时收费 | 医院+顾问+合同开始时间，依赖上面的假设 |
| PATIENT | 保险公司名称、保险单号 | 两项组合 |
| ADMISSION | 入院日期、时间、可选的已确定疾病，以及各项入院检查和结果 | 病人+医院+入院日期+入院时间，依赖上面的假设 |

检查等多值内容中的名称和对应结果要配对，不能保存为互不对应的两份列表。每小时收费在本设计中属于合同，可表达同一顾问在不同医院有不同收费。

### 组织和人员关联

```mermaid
classDiagram
    direction LR
    HOSPITAL "1" -- "1..*" BUILDING : contains_by_building_number
    HOSPITAL "0..1" -- "1" BUILDING : main_building
    BUILDING "1" -- "0..*" WARD : contains
    WARD "1" -- "1..*" DECK : contains_by_deck_number
    HOSPITAL "1" -- "1..*" EMPLOYEE : employs_by_employee_number
    EMPLOYEE <|-- DOCTOR
    EMPLOYEE <|-- NURSE
    EMPLOYEE <|-- ADMINISTRATION_STAFF
    EMPLOYEE <|-- MAINTENANCE_STAFF
    DOCTOR "0..*" -- "0..*" WARD : assigned_to
    NURSE "0..*" -- "0..*" DECK : assigned_to
```

病区属于一座建筑；分区属于一个病区。原题没有说明每位医生只能负责一个病区、每位护士只能负责一个分区，因此本图允许many-to-many，且不擅自规定最低分配数。

### 合同和入院关联

```mermaid
classDiagram
    direction LR
    HOSPITAL "1" -- "0..*" CONTRACT : contracts
    CONSULTANT "1" -- "0..*" CONTRACT : signs
    HOSPITAL "1" -- "0..*" ADMISSION : admits
    PATIENT "1" -- "0..*" ADMISSION : has
    ADMISSION "0..*" -- "0..1" DECK : placed_at
```

检查结果属于某一次入院，不能只放在病人名下，否则多次入院会混在一起。疾病尚未确定时，入院记录可以暂未分配分区；分配后，病区可由分区所属关系确定。

### 图外还需表达的业务限制

1. 医院的主楼必须属于该医院。
2. 分区必须位于所属病区所在的建筑；分区楼层属于该病区占用的楼层。
3. 入院所属医院必须和安置分区所属医院一致。
4. 合同结束不能早于开始；同一顾问可以同时在不同医院有有效合同。
5. 顾问不参加医生与病区之间的分配关联。

原文提到了出院，但没有要求记录出院日期或时间。本参考图不额外添加 discharge_time。若要完整的出入院时间历史，需先明确新增业务要求。

图中qualifier的数量解释：整体上，每个HOSPITAL至少有一座BUILDING和一名EMPLOYEE，每个WARD至少有一个DECK；黄色框把building_number、employee_number、deck_number作为局部identifier。固定所属对象与该局部号码后，目标端为0..1。这个0..1不会把医院整体限制为只有一座楼或一名员工。

parts.goal: 建立医院的局部标识、合同与反复入院模型
steps: 从HOSPITAL、BUILDING、WARD、DECK、EMPLOYEE、CONSULTANT、PATIENT七类主对象开始；员工细分四种，另外用CONTRACT、ADMISSION保存具有时间边界的事件。
按作用范围处理identifier：building_number与employee_number要结合医院；deck_number结合病区。病人使用保险公司与保单号的组合。医院电话、传真、邮箱分别是可用的独立标识方式。
每次ADMISSION保存入院date/time、这次检查的名称与结果；同一病人的不同入院不能共用一份检查列表。
把顾问与医院的合同独立表示，收费和起止时间按合同记录。顾问可以同时为多家医院工作，不把它加入医生的病区分配关联。
用BUILDING地址和DECK楼层确定位置；主楼属于本医院，病人分配的分区也必须属于入院医院。疾病未确定时允许暂未安置。
顾问唯一属性、合同开始时间组合及入院时间组合在原题未充分声明唯一性。把使用phone等自然标识的假设明确列出；不新建consultant_id或admission_id。

questions.question:
Consider a conceptual schema given below.

![Original conceptual schema](assets/mock-2-q2.jpg)

Your task is to perform a step of logical database design, i.e. to transform a conceptual schema given above into a collection of relational schemas. For each relational schema clearly list the names of attributes, primary key, candidate keys (if any), and foreign keys (if any). Assume, that a superset method must be used to implement a generalization.
questions.answer:
### FLIGHT：航班定义

flight_number 是航班identifier。计划时间属于航班定义。

```text
FLIGHT(
    flight_number, origin, destination,
    planned_departure_time, planned_arrival_time
)
PRIMARY KEY = (flight_number)
OTHER CANDIDATE KEYS = none
FOREIGN KEY1 = none
```

### AIRPLANE：飞机

registration 是飞机identifier。

```text
AIRPLANE(registration, type, total_seats)
PRIMARY KEY = (registration)
OTHER CANDIDATE KEYS = none
FOREIGN KEY1 = none
```

### FLIGHT_INSTANCE：某日的航班实例

date 是航班与实例之间的qualifier，因此实例的primary key由 flight_number 和 flight_date 组合构成。实际起飞、到达时间在图中可选，允许 NULL。飞机一端未画数量，本答案按 UML 默认1理解为每次实例使用一架飞机。

```text
FLIGHT_INSTANCE(
    flight_number, flight_date, gate, boarding_time,
    departure_time, arrival_time, registration
)
PRIMARY KEY = (flight_number, flight_date)
OTHER CANDIDATE KEYS = none
FOREIGN KEY1 = (flight_number) REFERENCES FLIGHT(flight_number)
FOREIGN KEY2 = (registration) REFERENCES AIRPLANE(registration)
```

### CREW：用超集法合并机组人员子类

airline 与 employee_number 共同识别人员。用 crew_type 区分类别；飞行员填写 licence_number，乘务员此列为空。本答案假设两类互斥且覆盖记录的全部人员；若允许兼任，需要能表达多重身份的分类方式。licence_number 只在飞行员中识别人，在整张合并表中是可空唯一标识，不是识别所有人员行的非空candidate key。

```text
CREW(
    airline, employee_number, first_name, last_name,
    crew_type, licence_number
)
PRIMARY KEY = (airline, employee_number)
CANDIDATE KEY1 = (licence_number)
FOREIGN KEY1 = none
```

### STEWARD_QUALIFICATION：乘务员的资格

一个乘务员可有多项资格，每项单独记录。foreign key只保证人员存在，不自动保证该人一定是乘务员，也不保证每位乘务员至少有一项资格。

```text
STEWARD_QUALIFICATION(airline, employee_number, qualification)
PRIMARY KEY = (airline, employee_number, qualification)
OTHER CANDIDATE KEYS = none
FOREIGN KEY1 = (airline, employee_number)
    REFERENCES CREW(airline, employee_number)
```

### SERVICE_CREW：某次航班的人员分配

role 表示某位机组人员在某次航班实例中的服务角色，所以放在分配表，而不是人员的永久属性中。primary key包含实例的完整键和人员的完整键。本答案按每一配对记录一个角色理解。foreign key不能单独保证每次实例至少有一位服务人员。

```text
SERVICE_CREW(flight_number, flight_date, airline, employee_number, role)
PRIMARY KEY = (flight_number, flight_date, airline, employee_number)
OTHER CANDIDATE KEYS = none
FOREIGN KEY1 = (flight_number, flight_date)
     REFERENCES FLIGHT_INSTANCE(flight_number, flight_date)
FOREIGN KEY2 = (airline, employee_number)
     REFERENCES CREW(airline, employee_number)
```

### 图中标签对照

**图中文字对照（仅翻译）**：FLIGHT 航班；FLIGHT-INSTANCE 某日的航班实例；AIRPLANE 飞机；CREW 机组人员；PILOT 飞行员；STEWARD 乘务员。flight-number 航班号；origin 始发地；destination 目的地；planned-departure-time 计划起飞时间；planned-arrival-tim（原图拼写）计划到达时间；date 日期；gate 登机口；boarding-time 登机时间；departure-time 实际起飞时间；arrival-time 实际到达时间；registration 注册号；type 类型；total-seats 总座位数；airline 航空公司；employee-number 员工号；first-name 名；last-name 姓；licence-number 执照号；qualifications 资格；role 此次服务的角色。Has 具有；Uses 使用；Services 提供服务。ID identifier；[0..1] 可选单值；[1..*] 至少一个值；* 零到多个；1..* 一个或多个；0..1 零个或一个。虚线框中的 role 是关联属性；空心三角表示泛化。

parts.goal: 把航班图按superset转换成六个schemas
steps: FLIGHT用flight_number识别；date是限定符，因此FLIGHT_INSTANCE用(flight_number,flight_date)组合识别。
AIRPLANE单独以registration作primary key；实例中保存registration foreign key。实际出发和到达时间可空，计划时间仍留在FLIGHT。
CREW的airline与employee_number共同标识人员。按superset把PILOT的licence_number放回CREW，用crew_type分类。
licence_number保留非空值唯一；课程格式可列为可选candidate key，但说明它只识别飞行员，不识别无执照号的乘务员行。
STEWARD的qualifications是multivalued，单独建STEWARD_QUALIFICATION。SERVICE_CREW处理实例与机组人员的many-to-many，role属于这次分配。
所有foreign keys都带完整组合；列出父表再列引用表。检查每实例至少一名机组、每乘务员至少一项资格等最低数量没有被普通foreign key自动实现。
parts.check: 六表为FLIGHT、AIRPLANE、FLIGHT_INSTANCE、CREW、STEWARD_QUALIFICATION、SERVICE_CREW。
parts.pitfall: 不要给FLIGHT_INSTANCE仅用date作primary key，或把role固定在CREW上。

questions.question:
This question is related to a sample database created through processing of the common CREATE TABLE statements above.

Write SELECT statements that implement the following queries. You can use any implementation technique for your SELECT statements.

(1) For each bank find the total number of branches owned by a bank. List a bank name and the total number of branches owned by a bank. Assume that some banks do not have any branches yet. In all such cases the total number of branches must be listed as zero (0).

(2) For all accounts that have no bank transactions in 2021, find the account numbers and balance on each account. List an account number and balance on each account.

(3) Find the names and emails of all banks, that have at least one branch with unknow total number of employees at a branch.

Write SQL statements that implement the following structural modifications of a database and data manipulations on the contents of a database. Note, that implementation of some of the tasks listed below may need more than one SQL statement. You are not allowed to drop and/or suspend any referential integrity constraints in your implementations

(4) We would like to add to a database information about the total number of bank transactions performed on each bank account. Modify the structures of a sample database in the best possible way. Insert appropriate information into the new structures of a sample database.

(5) Delete from a database information about all bank transactions submitted in a year 2019. Note, that you are not allowed to drop and/or suspend any referential integrity constraints in your implementation.
questions.answer:
### (1) 每家银行的分行数，包括0

从 BANK 出发LEFT JOIN BRANCH，保留没有分行的银行。COUNT(R.bank_name) 只数匹配的分行；COUNT(*) 会把外连接保留的空匹配行也计为1。

```sql
SELECT B.bank_name, COUNT(R.bank_name) AS total_branches
FROM BANK AS B
LEFT JOIN BRANCH AS R
    ON R.bank_name = B.bank_name
GROUP BY B.bank_name;
```

### (2) 2021年没有交易的账户

账户由账号与银行名共同识别，子查询必须同时匹配这两项。日期范围包含2021年1月1日，排除2022年1月1日。只有其他年份交易、或从未交易的账户，都满足题意。

```sql
SELECT A.account_num, A.balance
FROM ACCOUNT AS A
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM `TRANSACTION` AS T
    WHERE T.acc_num = A.account_num
      AND T.bank_name = A.bank_name
      AND T.tr_date_time >= '2021-01-01'
      AND T.tr_date_time <  '2022-01-01'
);
```

### (3) 有分行员工数未知的银行

未知对应 NULL，用 IS NULL 检查，不用 = NULL，也不把未知当作0。EXISTS 使一家银行即使有多个符合分行也只出现一次。

```sql
SELECT B.bank_name, B.email
FROM BANK AS B
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM BRANCH AS R
    WHERE R.bank_name = B.bank_name
      AND R.total_emps IS NULL
);
```

### (4) 增加交易总数并初始化

在 ACCOUNT 中增加 total_transactions 列，再根据现有 TRANSACTION 行逐账户计数，没有交易的账户为0。这是保存的派生统计值：以后交易增删后还需要维护或重算；本次 UPDATE 只完成初始化。若用实时视图，能避免保存冗余统计，但不等于本解的“新增列并填充”。

```sql
ALTER TABLE ACCOUNT
ADD COLUMN total_transactions BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

UPDATE ACCOUNT AS A
SET total_transactions = (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM `TRANSACTION` AS T
    WHERE T.acc_num = A.account_num
      AND T.bank_name = A.bank_name
);
```

### (5) 删除2019年交易

只删除交易子表中的目标记录，无需删除账户，也无需暂停foreign key。如果本小题接在(4)之后执行，已保存的交易总数也需要重新计算。

```sql
DELETE FROM `TRANSACTION`
WHERE tr_date_time >= '2019-01-01'
  AND tr_date_time <  '2020-01-01';
```

LEFT JOIN BRANCH，按bank_name分组。
统计右表非空bank_name，只数真正存在的分行。


questions.question:
This question is related to a sample database created through processing of the common CREATE TABLE statements above.

An objective of this question is to explain how to implement a simple method of auditing the database activities.

Assume, that a database administrator would like to audit the data manipulation statements (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) processed by a selected group of users on a selected group of relational tables. Write SQL statements and in the comments provide the comprehensive explanation of a role of SQL statement plays in the implementation of a simple database auditing system.
questions.answer:
这是原模拟保留的扩展题。此方法记录收到的语句，不证明语句执行成功或已经提交。

简单文本筛选可能漏掉或误选复杂语句；它不是通用 SQL 解析器。按行记录的触发器审计也不同于语句日志：一条语句可能改多行、零行，且事务回滚会影响行审计记录。

### 简单审计示例

本例由管理员开启 MySQL general query log，保存收到的语句，再从中筛选指定用户和表。假定目标用户为 admin、clerk，目标表为 banks.ACCOUNT 和 banks.TRANSACTION；并假定他们在审计期间只访问 banks，使用普通单表 INSERT、UPDATE、DELETE。SQL 注释逐步说明作用。

```sql
-- 1. 由 DBA 保存现有日志设置，以便审计后恢复。
SET @old_general_log = @@GLOBAL.general_log;
SET @old_log_output = @@GLOBAL.log_output;

-- 2. 暂停日志写入，设置 TABLE 输出，再启用日志。
-- TABLE 让后续 SQL 可以从 mysql.general_log 查询日志。
SET GLOBAL general_log = 'OFF';
SET GLOBAL log_output = 'TABLE';
SET @audit_start = NOW(6);
SET GLOBAL general_log = 'ON';

-- 3. 现在由被审计用户在各自连接中执行待审计操作。
-- DBA 保留当前连接，等待指定的审计期间结束。
-- 不能把审计用户的操作改在 root 连接中执行，否则用户身份不对。

-- 4. 审计期间结束后停止写入，记录结束时间。
SET GLOBAL general_log = 'OFF';
SET @audit_end = NOW(6);

-- 5. 将期间内指定用户的 DML 日志筛选并保存为普通报告表。
-- user_host 包含用户名及连接来源；这里取左方的用户名。
-- argument 是语句内容，先转成字符文本再进行正则匹配。
-- 第一项正则选 INSERT、UPDATE、DELETE；第二项选目标表名。
CREATE TABLE banks.AUDIT_REPORT AS
SELECT event_time,
       user_host,
       thread_id,
       CONVERT(argument USING utf8mb4) AS statement_text
FROM mysql.general_log
WHERE event_time >= @audit_start
  AND event_time <= @audit_end
  AND command_type = 'Query'
  AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(user_host, '[', 1) IN ('admin', 'clerk')
  AND REGEXP_LIKE(
      CONVERT(argument USING utf8mb4),
      '^[[:space:]]*(INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE)[[:space:]]', 'i'
  )
  AND REGEXP_LIKE(
      CONVERT(argument USING utf8mb4),
      '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])(ACCOUNT|TRANSACTION)([^[:alnum:]_]|$)', 'i'
  );

-- 6. 查看谁、何时、在哪个连接提交了什么语句。
SELECT event_time, user_host, thread_id, statement_text
FROM banks.AUDIT_REPORT
ORDER BY event_time, thread_id;

-- 7. 报告表由 DBA 管理；不给被审计用户修改报告的权限。
-- 恢复审计前的日志输出方式与开关状态。
SET GLOBAL log_output = @old_log_output;
SET GLOBAL general_log = @old_general_log;
```

Assume that CREATE TABLE statements listed above are included in SQL script dbcreate.sql. The script is located at a folder $HOME/bank/sql. (2) A user root would like to create within a database banks, the relational tables given on page 3 of the examination paper.

(4) A user admin must have the rights to execute CREATE TABLE and CREATE VIEW statements with the rights to propagate the privilege to the other users.

(5) A user admin must have the rights to read information about all bank transactions submitted in 2021 with no rights to propagate the privilege to the other users.

### (1) 创建并选定banks数据库

```sql
CREATE DATABASE banks;
USE banks;
```

### (2) 在mysql客户端处理建表脚本

SOURCE 是 mysql 客户端命令。这里用 ~ 表示运行客户端的操作系统用户主目录；如果环境不展开它，换成实际绝对路径。不能把数据库 root 身份当成操作系统 /root，也不能假定客户端会像 shell 一样展开字面量 $HOME。

```text

```

### (3) 创建admin账号

```sql
CREATE USER 'admin'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY '[CHOOSE_PASSWORD]';
```

### (4) 授予建表和建视图权限，并允许转授

CREATE 用于建表；CREATE VIEW 是独立权限。WITH GRANT OPTION 允许转授对应范围的对象权限。

```sql
GRANT CREATE, CREATE VIEW ON banks.*
TO 'admin'@'localhost'
WITH GRANT OPTION;
```

### (5) 只开放2021年交易的读取

视图限定行范围，使用包含2021年起点、排除2022年起点的条件。为同时满足(4)和(5)，本解把只读视图放在单独的 bank_reports 数据库：admin 在 banks.* 已有数据库级 GRANT OPTION，若视图也放在 banks 中，单纯在新 GRANT 中省略这个选项，不一定能阻止转授新获得的读取权。root 创建定义者权限视图后，只开放该视图，不开放底表。

```sql
CREATE DATABASE bank_reports;

CREATE SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW bank_reports.TRANSACTIONS_2021 AS
SELECT acc_num, bank_name, tr_date_time, amount, type
FROM banks.`TRANSACTION`
WHERE tr_date_time >= '2021-01-01'
  AND tr_date_time <  '2022-01-01';

GRANT SELECT ON bank_reports.TRANSACTIONS_2021
TO 'admin'@'localhost';
```

questions.sourceNote: User-provided Questions 1–6; Q3–Q5 text attachments
questions.question:
This question is related to a sample database created through processing of the common CREATE TABLE statements above.

(1) Consider a bank that has a name NAB. Assume, that at the moment, the balance on account number 1 is equal to 100. Assume, that at the moment, the balance on account number 2 is equal to 200.

Assume, that concurrently processed database transactions T1 and T2 interleaved their operations in a way listed below.

```text
T1                                           T2
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE;
                                             SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE;
UPDATE ACCOUNT
SET balance = balance + 10
WHERE account_num = 1 AND
      bank_name = 'NAB';
                                             UPDATE ACCOUNT
                                             SET balance = balance + 20
                                             WHERE account_num = 1 AND
                                                   bank_name = 'NAB';

UPDATE ACCOUNT
SET balance = (SELECT balance + 10
               FROM ACCOUNT
               WHERE account_num = 1 AND
                     bank_name = 'NAB')
WHERE account_num = 1 AND
      bank_name = 'NAB';

COMMIT;
                                             COMMIT;
```

(1) Explain how the values of an attribute balance in the rows where account_num = 1 and account_num = 2 in NAB bank change after each UPDATE statement.

(2) Consider a bank that has a name NAB. Assume, that at the moment, the balance on account number 1 is equal to 100. Assume, that at the moment, the balance on account number 2 is equal to 200.

Assume, that concurrently processed database transactions T1 and T2 interleaved their operations in a way listed below.

```text
T1                                              T2
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
                                                SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
UPDATE ACCOUNT
SET balance = balance + 10
WHERE account_num = 1 AND
      bank_name = 'NAB';
                                                UPDATE ACCOUNT
                                                SET balance = balance + 20
                                                WHERE account_num = 2 AND
                                                      bank_name = 'NAB';
                                                COMMIT;
UPDATE ACCOUNT
SET balance = (SELECT balance + 10
               FROM ACCOUNT
               WHERE account_num = 2 AND
                     bank_name = 'NAB')
WHERE account_num = 1 AND
      bank_name = 'NAB';
COMMIT;
```

Explain how the values of an attribute balance in the rows where account_num = 1 and account_num = 2 change after processing of each UPDATE statement.

Answer text Question 6
questions.answer:
本题要区分“题目想说明的账户变化”和“把原 SQL 直接放到某一数据库中能否运行”。以下先假设两个事务已经开始，并以等价、可执行的语句完成题目描述的操作。

### (1) 两个事务都为SERIALIZABLE

1. T1 先把账户1从100改到110；账户2仍为200。
2. T2 也要修改账户1，在 T1 持锁期间等待，此时尚未成功增加20。
3. T1 能读到自己的110，再增加10，把账户1改到120；账户2仍为200。
4. T1 提交之后，T2 怎样继续取决于具体数据库的冲突处理规则。

| 采用的环境 | T2后续处理 | 最终余额：账户1、账户2 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| MySQL InnoDB，显式事务，等待未超时，使用等价合法SQL | 等待结束后读取当前120，再加20并提交 | 140、200 |
| lecture B第13份事务讲义第16–17页的Oracle示例规则，且不重试 | 冲突的修改发生serialization error，未成功加20 | 120、200 |

不能只凭 SERIALIZABLE 这个级别名称，认定所有数据库的等待或失败行为完全相同。

在 MySQL 中，T1 第二次“给同一账户再加10”可等价写为：

```sql
UPDATE ACCOUNT
SET balance = balance + 10
WHERE account_num = 1
  AND bank_name = 'NAB';
```

### (2) T1为READ COMMITTED，T2为READ UNCOMMITTED

本小题重新从100、200开始。

| 操作 | 账户1 | 账户2 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| T1给账户1加10 | 110，未提交 | 200 |
| T2给账户2加20 | 110，未提交 | 220，未提交 |
| T2提交 | 110，未提交 | 220，已提交 |
| T1读取账户2的220，加10后赋给账户1 | 230，未提交 | 220 |
| T1提交 | 230，已提交 | 220 |

这里是把“账户2余额+10”整个结果写入账户1，不是在账户1的110上继续加10。T2已在读取前提交，所以这个顺序没有脏读。隔离级别允许某类现象，不表示本次一定出现该现象。

MySQL中的等价self-join写法如下：

```sql
UPDATE ACCOUNT AS A1
JOIN ACCOUNT AS A2
    ON A2.account_num = 2
   AND A2.bank_name = 'NAB'
SET A1.balance = A2.balance + 10
WHERE A1.account_num = 1
  AND A1.bank_name = 'NAB';
```

### 字面执行原SQL时还缺少的条件

原题没有列 START TRANSACTION；SET TRANSACTION 本身不会开启跨多条语句的显式事务。原题直接在 UPDATE ACCOUNT 的子查询中读取 ACCOUNT，还涉及 MySQL 的 Error 1093 限制，失败的更新不能算成已经改好余额。

若保留 MySQL 默认自动提交、字面执行原题，且出错后继续运行，(1)余额会是130、200，(2)会是110、220；两小题的第二次 T1 UPDATE 都未成功。因此上面的不同结果属于不同执行条件，不是同一条件下有多个随意答案。参考资料不把其中一种冒充学校官方判分结论。

parts.goal: 追踪同账户写冲突，并写明数据库模型
steps: 分别记录两个事务的操作，不把等待的UPDATE算作已经成功。T1先将账户1从100变110。
T2请求同一行，在T1持锁时等待；T1第二次能读自己的110，再写120并提交。
MySQL InnoDB合法等价SQL下，等待未超时则T2随后在120上加20得到140；课件Oracle SERIALIZABLE模型可能发生serialization error，未重试则保持120。
账户2未被任何语句修改，始终200。最后区分题意事务与字面MySQL SQL：原文缺START TRANSACTION，且同表子查询UPDATE可能Error1093。
parts.check: 对140或120写明条件；原SQL失败不能当成功更新。
parts.pitfall: SERIALIZABLE规定可串行化语义，不承诺每种DBMS用完全相同的等待/重试机制。
parts.code:
```sql
UPDATE ACCOUNT
SET balance = balance + 10
WHERE account_num = 1
  AND bank_name = 'NAB';
```

parts.goal: 追踪跨账户赋值
steps: 本小题重新从100、200开始，不沿用上一题余额。
T1把账户1加到110，T2把账户2加到220并提交。
T1再读取账户2的220，把220+10整个结果赋给账户1，所以得到230，而非120。
T1提交后余额为230、220；读取发生在T2提交后，这条顺序没有dirty read。实际MySQL示范使用合法self-join并显式开事务。
parts.check: READ UNCOMMITTED允许某些现象，不代表本次一定读取到未提交数据。
parts.pitfall: 把SET balance=(账户2+10)误算成“账户1再加10”。
parts.code:
```sql
UPDATE ACCOUNT AS A1
JOIN ACCOUNT AS A2
    ON A2.account_num = 2
   AND A2.bank_name = 'NAB'
SET A1.balance = A2.balance + 10
WHERE A1.account_num = 1
  AND A1.bank_name = 'NAB';
```

questions.question:
Consider a local library that wants to maintain information about its books and authors. The  following business rules apply: 
• Each Book has ISBN, Title, Edition, and Publication Year. ISBN uniquely identifies a  book. 
• Each Author has AuthorID, FirstName, and LastName. AuthorID uniquely identifies an  author. 
• A book is written by one or more authors. 
• An author may write zero or more books. 
• The library may own multiple copies of the same book. 
• Each Copy has CopyID, and Status (e.g., Available or On Loan). CopyID uniquely  identifies a copy.  
• Each Copy represents exactly one Book. 
• Each Member has MemberID, FirstName, LastName, and Email. MemberID uniquely  identifies a member. 
• A Member may borrow zero or more Copies. A Copy may be borrowed by at most one  Member at a time.  Using the CSIT115 Palette in UMLet, create a conceptual schema that satisfies the requirements  above. Your diagram must include all required entities with their specified attributes and correct  multiplicity (cardinality).  Finally, add one meaningful attribute to one of the classes that is not listed above. The attribute  should be appropriate for the scenario and the custom attribute you create must end with your  Student ID (e.g., `Genre_1234567`).
questions.answer:
用 BOOK 表示书目，COPY 表示图书馆持有的一本实体书。一本书目可以有多个副本，两个概念要分开。

| 类 | 属性与标识 |
| --- | --- |
| BOOK | ISBN为identifier；另有Title、Edition、PublicationYear，以及原题要求的一项自选属性，例如Genre_example_StudentID（作答时换成自己的学号） |
| AUTHOR | AuthorID为identifier；另有FirstName、LastName |
| COPY | CopyID为identifier；另有Status |
| MEMBER | MemberID为identifier；另有FirstName、LastName、Email |

```mermaid
classDiagram
    AUTHOR "1..*" -- "0..*" BOOK : writes
    BOOK "1" -- "0..*" COPY : has
    MEMBER "0..1" -- "0..*" COPY : borrows
```

一项书目至少有一位作者；一位作者可以暂时没有书目。每个副本对应一个书目；此图没有额外要求每个书目至少有一个副本。一个会员可以借多个副本，一个副本同一时刻至多有一名借阅者。

原题明确 CopyID 唯一，因此它本身必须能识别副本。随附参考图若把它画成依赖书目的局部编号，仍不能因此丢掉题面声明的全局唯一条件。题目没有要求借阅历史，本设计没有额外添加借阅日期或人工借阅编号。

parts.goal: 把书目、实体副本、作者与会员分开建模
steps: 同一种书的ISBN、Title、Edition、PublicationYear属于BOOK；图书馆实际持有的某一本属于COPY，有CopyID和Status。
AUTHOR用AuthorID、MEMBER用MemberID识别；COPY的CopyID按文字是全局唯一。
BOOK到AUTHOR：每书目至少一作者，作者可暂未有书目。BOOK到COPY：每副本只对应一书目，一书目可有多副本。
MEMBER到COPY：会员可借零到多本；同一副本同一时刻至多借给一人。原题只表达当前借阅，不擅加历史LoanID。
最后按这道作业特有要求，增加一项有意义且带本人学号后缀的attribute。不能把这个要求套进禁止额外属性的医院题。

questions.topic: 修正大学概念模型
questions.sourceNote: Assignment1.pdf pp3–4
questions.question:
The university has the following business rules. 
 
1. Each lecturer has a Staff ID, First Name, Last Name and Email.  
2. Each student has a Student ID, First Name, Last Name and Email and every student is either  an Undergraduate student or a Postgraduate student. An undergraduate student has an  additional attribute GPA and a postgraduate student has an additional attribute Thesis Title. 
3. Each subject has a Code, Title and Credits.  
4. Each subject is offered by one department with an attribute Name. 
5. Each classroom has a Room Number, Building and Capacity.  
6. A lecturer may teach up to four subjects in a semester.  
7. Each subject must be taught by at most two lecturers and is held in one classroom. 
8. A student may enrol in zero or more subjects.  
9. A classroom may be used for zero or more subjects.    Correct the conceptual schema by fixing all errors in entity representation, inheritance notation,  and multiplicities so that it accurately represents the business rules above.

![Original conceptual schema](assets/assignment-1-task-2.png)
questions.answer:
按照文字业务规则修正，不按照待纠错图继续推断。最终类如下：

| 类 | 应有属性 |
| --- | --- |
| LECTURER | StaffID、FirstName、LastName、Email |
| STUDENT | StudentID、FirstName、LastName、Email |
| UNDERGRADUATE | 继承STUDENT，增加GPA |
| POSTGRADUATE | 继承STUDENT，增加ThesisTitle |
| SUBJECT | Code、Title、Credits |
| DEPARTMENT | Name |
| CLASSROOM | RoomNumber、Building、Capacity |

```mermaid
classDiagram
    STUDENT <|-- UNDERGRADUATE
    STUDENT <|-- POSTGRADUATE
    LECTURER "1..2" -- "0..4" SUBJECT : teaches
    DEPARTMENT "1" -- "0..*" SUBJECT : offers
    CLASSROOM "1" -- "0..*" SUBJECT : holds
    STUDENT "0..*" -- "0..*" SUBJECT : enrols
```

修正点：

1. 增加本科生子类；本科生、研究生的泛化箭头都指向 STUDENT。每位学生恰好属于二者之一。
2. 单独表示 DEPARTMENT，用关联说明哪个系开设科目；不只在 SUBJECT 中留一个 DepartmentName 代替系这个类。
3. 为 CLASSROOM 补上 RoomNumber。每个科目对应一间教室；一间教室可用于零门或多门科目。
4. 一位讲师对应零至四门科目，0..4 写在科目端。每门科目最多两名讲师，对应的数量写在讲师端。
5. 学生可以零门或多门选课；原题没有强制每门科目至少有学生。

questions.question:
Given the conceptual schema below, perform logical database design by transforming it  into a collection of relational schemas. 

(1) Identify each feature of the conceptual schema that requires a transformation and state  the transformation applied to that feature. 

(2) For each relational schema created , clearly list the names of attributes, primary keys ,  candidate keys (if any), and foreign keys (if any). Assume that the superset  method must be used to implement a generalization (if any). A way how a conceptual  schema can be transformed into a collection of relational schemas is explained in a  presentation 06 Logical Design.      The relational schemas must be listed in a format presented in slides 42 and 43 in  presentation 06 Logical Design. Listing of the relational schemas in the other format scores  no marks.   

Note that the order of the definitions on the relation schemas is important. You must  define a parent relation schema (referenced) before its  child relational schema  (references to the parent relational schema).

![Original conceptual schema](assets/assignment-2-task-1.png)
questions.answer:
以下根据随附 Assignment2_Solution.pdf 整理转换方法。按同一顺序理解每项特征：原图表达什么，需要怎样落到关系结构中。

1. **酒店的多值设施属性**：先建立 AMENITY，再用 HOTEL_AMENITY 记录酒店与设施的配对。一家酒店可以有多种设施，同种设施也可以用于多家酒店。
2. **住客与预订的many-to-many关联**：建立 GUEST_RESERVATION，以住客标识与预订标识的组合作primary key。
3. **酒店与客房的限定关联**：roomNo只在所属酒店内识别客房，因此 ROOM 的primary key为 hotelCode 与 roomNo 的组合，hotelCode同时引用 HOTEL。
4. **客房与预订的one-to-many关联**：把 ROOM 的完整primary key复制到 RESERVATION，形成引用客房的composite foreign key。
5. **预订与付款的可选one-to-one关联**：按随附解答，将 PAYMENT 合并到 RESERVATION。没有付款时，receiptNo、amount、method、paidDate为空；有付款时保存付款信息。
6. **酒店的generalization**：用 superset method，把两类酒店的专有属性放回 HOTEL，再增加 typeOfHotel 区分类型。

最终relational schema如下，父关系先于子关系：

```text
GUEST(passportNo, firstName, lastName, email, phone) 
PRIMARY KEY = (passportNo) 
AMENITY(amenity) 
PRIMARY KEY = (amenity) 
HOTEL(code, name, rating, typeOfHotel, poolCount, conferenceRooms) 
PRIMARY KEY = (code) 
ROOM(hotelCode, roomNo, capacity, bedType, pricePerNight) 
PRIMARY KEY = (hotelCode, roomNo) 
FOREIGN KEY1 = (hotelCode) REFERENCES HOTEL(code) 

RESERVATION(reservationNo, checkIn, checkOut, bookingDate, status, 
            hotelCode, roomNo, receiptNo, amount, method, paidDate) 
PRIMARY KEY = (reservationNo) 
CANDIDATE KEY1 = (receiptNo) 
FOREIGN KEY1 = (hotelCode, roomNo) REFERENCES ROOM(hotelCode, roomNo) 
HOTEL_AMENITY(hotelCode, amenity) 
PRIMARY KEY = (hotelCode, amenity) 
FOREIGN KEY1 = (hotelCode) REFERENCES HOTEL(code) 
FOREIGN KEY2 = (amenity) REFERENCES AMENITY(amenity) 
GUEST_RESERVATION (passportNo, reservationNo) 
PRIMARY KEY = (passportNo, reservationNo) 
FOREIGN KEY1 = (passportNo) REFERENCES GUEST(passportNo) 
FOREIGN KEY2 = (reservationNo) REFERENCES RESERVATION(reservationNo)
```

这里 receiptNo 的用语要特别区分：随附课程解答把它列作 CK，但没有付款的预订中它为空。因此严格说它不是标识所有预订行的非空candidate key，而是“有付款时唯一的收据号”。用 UNIQUE(receiptNo) 保留非空值唯一的条件。

foreign key不会单独强制many-to-many关联两端“至少有一条”的最低数量。合并子类后，还要根据采用的类型规则保证专有属性填写相符。

### 图中标签对照

**图中文字对照**：GUEST 住客；RESERVATION 预订；PAYMENT 付款；ROOM 房间；HOTEL 酒店；RESORT_HOTEL 度假酒店；BUSINESS_HOTEL 商务酒店。passportNo 护照号；firstName 名；lastName 姓；email 邮箱；phone 电话；reservationNo 预订号；checkIn 入住日期；checkOut 退房日期；bookingDate 预订日期；status 状态；receipt# 收据号；amount 金额；method 付款方式；paidDate 付款日期；capacity 容量；bedType 床型；pricePerNight 每晚价格；room# 房号；code 酒店代码；name 名称；amenity 配套设施；rating 评分；poolCount 泳池数量；conferenceRooms 会议室数量。Includes 包含；Has 具有；Related to 与之相关。ID1 identifier；[*] 多值；[0..1] 可选；* 零到多个；1..* 至少一个；0..1 零个或一个；空心三角表示泛化。

parts.goal: 说明每一种概念特征如何转换
steps: 先列多值amenity、GUEST到RESERVATION的many-to-many、HOTEL到ROOM的qualification。
再列ROOM到RESERVATION的one-to-many、RESERVATION到PAYMENT的可选one-to-one，以及HOTEL的generalization。
逐项写采用的转换：多值表/关联表、复制完整owner key、复制foreign key、按课程示例合并可选付款、按superset合并酒店子类。

parts.goal: 写全部relational schemas及键
steps: 先列GUEST、AMENITY、HOTEL；再列ROOM、RESERVATION、HOTEL_AMENITY、GUEST_RESERVATION。
ROOM primary key为(hotelCode,roomNo)；RESERVATION同时引用这两项，不只引用房号。
PAYMENT合并后用可空receiptNo保存付款唯一标识；课程把它列作CK，解析单独说明可空标识与严格candidate key定义差异。
按课件格式写PRIMARY KEY、CANDIDATE KEY、FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES；父表在前。

questions.question:
This question builds upon the relational schemas you designed in Task 1.  Write SQL  statements to answer the following queries. Since the parts  are interconnected, you must  complete them in sequential order from (1) to (5).  

(1) Create empty relational tables to implement the relational schemas you designed in  Task 1 for the hotel reservation database. The names of the relational tables and  columns must be consistent with your logical design. Use reasonable column types  and sizes (lengths). Enforce all appropriate primary key and referential integrity  constraints.  Note that the order of CREATE TABLE statements is important. Create the  parent table (referenced) before its child table (references to the parent table).  

(2) Next, assume that a new business rule is introduced requiring that no two guests  have the same email address. Add an appropriate constraint after the table has  already been created. 

(3) Next, insert sufficient sample data into the tables to represent at least two hotels,  two rooms for each hotel, two guests, and two reservations. Insert appropriate data  into the other tables resulting from your logical design where required.  The data values are up to you, but they must satisfy all primary key and referential  integrity constraints defined in part (1) and (2).    Note that the order of INSERT statements is important. Insert data into the  parent table (referenced) before inserting data into its child table (references to  the parent table).  

(4) Increase the pricePerNight of all rooms belonging to one of the hotels inserted  in part (3) by 10%. The choice of hotel is up to you. 

(5) Finally, delete one of the hotels inserted in part ( 3) and all records that must be  removed beforehand to satisfy the referential integrity constraints. Do not delete the  other hotel or its related information, and do not drop any table.    Note that the order of delete statements is important. Delete data from the child table  (references to the parent table) before deleting data from its parent table (referenced).
questions.answer:
### (1) 先创建父表，再创建引用它的表

以下(1)–(4)沿用随附参考解答的表名、列名和样例数据。

```sql
CREATE TABLE GUEST ( 
    passportNo VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
    firstName  VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
    lastName   VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
    email      VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
    phone      VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
    CONSTRAINT guest_pkey PRIMARY KEY (passportNo) 
); 
CREATE TABLE AMENITY ( 
    amenity VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
    CONSTRAINT amenity_pkey PRIMARY KEY (amenity) 
); 
CREATE TABLE HOTEL ( 
    code             CHAR(5) NOT NULL, 
    name             VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
    rating           DECIMAL(2,1) NULL, 
    typeOfHotel      VARCHAR(20) NULL, 
    poolCount        DECIMAL(3) NULL, 
    conferenceRooms  DECIMAL(3) NULL, 
    CONSTRAINT hotel_pkey PRIMARY KEY (code) 
); 
CREATE TABLE ROOM ( 
    hotelCode      CHAR(5) NOT NULL, 
    roomNo         VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
    capacity       DECIMAL(2) NOT NULL, 
    bedType        VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
    pricePerNight  DECIMAL(8,2) NOT NULL, 
    CONSTRAINT room_pkey PRIMARY KEY (hotelCode, roomNo), 
    CONSTRAINT room_fkey1 FOREIGN KEY (hotelCode) 
        REFERENCES HOTEL(code) 
); 
CREATE TABLE RESERVATION ( 
    reservationNo  CHAR(6) NOT NULL, 
    checkIn        DATE NOT NULL, 
    checkOut       DATE NOT NULL, 
    bookingDate    DATE NOT NULL, 
    status         VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
    hotelCode      CHAR(5) NOT NULL, 
    roomNo         VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
    receiptNo      VARCHAR(20) NULL, 
    amount         DECIMAL(8,2) NULL, 
    method         VARCHAR(20) NULL, 
    paidDate       DATE NULL, 
    CONSTRAINT reservation_pkey PRIMARY KEY (reservationNo), 
    CONSTRAINT reservation_ckey1 UNIQUE (receiptNo), 
    CONSTRAINT reservation_fkey1 FOREIGN KEY (hotelCode, roomNo) 
        REFERENCES ROOM(hotelCode, roomNo) 
); 
CREATE TABLE HOTEL_AMENITY ( 
    hotelCode  CHAR(5) NOT NULL, 
    amenity    VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
    CONSTRAINT hotel_amenity_pkey PRIMARY KEY (hotelCode, amenity), 
    CONSTRAINT hotel_amenity_fkey1 FOREIGN KEY (hotelCode) 
        REFERENCES HOTEL(code), 
    CONSTRAINT hotel_amenity_fkey2 FOREIGN KEY (amenity) 
        REFERENCES AMENITY(amenity) 
); 

CREATE TABLE GUEST_RESERVATION ( 
    passportNo      VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
    reservationNo   CHAR(6) NOT NULL, 
    CONSTRAINT guest_reservation_pkey PRIMARY KEY (passportNo, reservationNo), 
    CONSTRAINT guest_reservation_fkey1 FOREIGN KEY (passportNo) 
        REFERENCES GUEST(passportNo), 
    CONSTRAINT guest_reservation_fkey2 FOREIGN KEY (reservationNo) 
        REFERENCES RESERVATION(reservationNo) 
);
```

### (2) 追加邮箱唯一约束

GUEST 已建好，再通过 ALTER TABLE 增加 UNIQUE(email)，防止两位住客使用相同的非空邮箱。此例中的邮箱列本身也为NOT NULL。

```sql
ALTER TABLE GUEST 
ADD CONSTRAINT guest_ckey1 UNIQUE (email);
```

### (3) 插入满足数量要求的数据

样例包含两家酒店，每家两间房，两位住客和两条预订；另外插入必要的设施及关联记录。先有被引用记录，再插入引用它的记录。

### (4) H001全部房间的价格提高10%

原价乘1.10。只筛选H001，不影响另一家酒店。

### (5) 删除H001及必须先删除的关联记录

先删除关联到该酒店预订的住客—预订配对，再删除预订、酒店—设施配对、客房，最后删除酒店。住客和设施可独立存在，保留它们。此写法通过酒店条件选择全部相关预订，而不只依赖样例中的一个预订号。

Note that you may need more than one SQL statement to implement a single subtask  listed below.    Your implementation must directly follow a comment with the specifications of a  subtask.  Implement SQL DDL (Data Definition Language) statements for questions (1) and (2)  below. 

(1)  Modify the structure and consistency constraint of the sample database such that the  fee of each workshop must be a positive value not larger than 9999.99. 

(2)  Modify the structure and consistency constraints of the sample database such that a  qualification level possessed by a participant and a qualification level required by a  workshop must be positive values no more than 10.  Implement SQL DML (Data Manipulation Language) statements for questions (3), (4)  and (5) below.  Note that you are not allowed to modify and/or drop any consistency constraints. We  assume that safe update has been disabled so that SQL can execute DML statements  anywhere. 

(3)  Add a new workshop (workshopNo=9) to the sample database. The values of the  new Workshop columns are up to you. Add two qualification requirements for the new  workshop. The qualification names, required levels and mandatory values are up to you. 

(4)  Modify the qualification levels possessed by participant (participantNo=3) such  that all qualification levels possessed by the participant increase by 1. 

(5)  Remove participant (participantNo=10) and all information related to this  participant from the sample database.
questions.answer:
以原始dbcreate.sql为起点。原文件没有对应的费用或等级CHECK，所以直接添加；如果练习库已经改过，应先核对实际约束，避免留下互相冲突的旧条件。

### (1) 同时修改费用类型和取值约束

原 fee 为DECIMAL(5,2)，只有三位整数位置，存不下9999.99。改为DECIMAL(6,2)，再增加费用大于0且不超过9999.99的CHECK。

```sql
ALTER TABLE Workshop
    MODIFY COLUMN fee DECIMAL(6,2) NOT NULL,
    ADD CONSTRAINT workshop_fee_check CHECK (fee > 0 AND fee <= 9999.99);
```

### (2) 两个资格等级列都要修改

原qlevel与requiredLevel都是DECIMAL(1)，存不下10。把两列都扩大为DECIMAL(2,0)，分别加上大于0且不超过10的检查。

```sql
ALTER TABLE Qualification
    MODIFY COLUMN qlevel DECIMAL(2,0) NOT NULL,
    ADD CONSTRAINT qualification_level_check CHECK (qlevel > 0 AND qlevel <= 10);

ALTER TABLE Requirement
    MODIFY COLUMN requiredLevel DECIMAL(2,0) NOT NULL,
    ADD CONSTRAINT requirement_level_check
        CHECK (requiredLevel > 0 AND requiredLevel <= 10);
```

### (3) 先增加工作坊，再增加两条资格要求

工作坊编号为9。其他值由题目允许自行选择。Requirement的qname没有引用Qualification.qname的foreign key，因此不必先给某位参与者增加同名资格。

```sql
INSERT INTO Workshop
    (workshopNo, title, category, `date`, fee, capacity)
VALUES (9, 'DATABASE PRACTICE', 'TECHNOLOGY', '2026-11-06', 200.00, 30);

INSERT INTO Requirement (workshopNo, qname, requiredLevel, mandatory)
VALUES (9, 'PYTHON PROGRAMMING', 3, 'Y'),
       (9, 'DATA ANALYSIS', 2, 'N');
```

### (4) 把参与者3的每项资格等级加1

更新Qualification中participantNo为3的所有行。原装载数据的4和3变为5和4，没有超过上限。若一般数据已有10，不能为了让更新成功就删除CHECK。

```sql
UPDATE Qualification
SET qlevel = qlevel + 1
WHERE participantNo = 3;
```

### (5) 先删子记录，再删参与者10

引用Participant的相关记录在Enrolment和Qualification中。先删这两处，再删Participant；不应删除与该人报名有关但能独立存在的工作坊或培训师。

```sql

DELETE FROM Qualification WHERE participantNo = 10;
DELETE FROM Participant WHERE participantNo = 10;
```

questions.question:
(1)  Find the workshop number, title, category and fee of all workshops whose fees are  between 150.00 and 220.00. 

(2)  Find the participant number and full name of all participants who live in Sydney. 

(3)  Find the participant number for all participants who possess more than 3  qualifications. 

(4)  Display the workshop number, title, fee and category of all workshops in ascending  order of category, then in descending order of fee. 

(5)  Find the average fee of workshops in the TECHNOLOGY category.
questions.answer:
按五小题顺序编写：

1. WHERE筛选150.00到220.00，包含两端，并列出题目指定的四列。
2. 在Participant中筛选Sydney；用CONCAT把名和姓合成fullName。
3. 在Qualification中按参与者分组，用HAVING保留资格条数大于3的人。
4. ORDER BY先指定category升序，再指定fee降序。
5. 先筛选TECHNOLOGY，再计算AVG(fee)。

原装载数据中：(1)工作坊编号1、2、3、5；(2)参与者编号1、4、7；(3)只有参与者7；(5)平均费用为650/3，约216.6667。没有ORDER BY的小题，不依赖结果的显示顺序。

```sql
SELECT workshopNo, title, category, fee
FROM Workshop
WHERE fee BETWEEN 150.00 AND 220.00;

-- (2)
SELECT participantNo, CONCAT(fname, ' ', lname) AS fullName
FROM Participant
WHERE UPPER(city) = 'SYDNEY';

-- (3)
SELECT participantNo
FROM Qualification
GROUP BY participantNo
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;

-- (4)
SELECT workshopNo, title, fee, category
FROM Workshop
ORDER BY category ASC, fee DESC;

-- (5)

FROM Workshop
WHERE category = 'TECHNOLOGY';
```

questions.sourceNote: Assignment3.pdf pp3–4,6,8; original dbcreate.sql and dbload.sql
questions.question:
You must implement SQL statements for the questions below by using JOIN / OUTER  JOIN.    Your implementation must directly follow a comment with a specification of a subtask. 

(1)  Find the full name and phone number of all participants who possess more than 2  qualifications and display the results in ascending order of last name and first name. 

(2)  Find the workshop number, title and category of all workshops that have no  qualification requirements. 

(3)  Find the participant number, full name and total number of workshop enrolments for  each participant and display the results in ascending order of the total number of  enrolments. Participants who have not enrolled in a workshop must also be included. 

(4)  Find the workshop number, title and total number of trainers assigned to each  workshop and display the results in ascending order of the total number of trainers.  Workshops that have no trainer assigned must also be included. 

(5)  Find the trainer number and full name of all trainers who have not been assigned to  any workshop.
questions.answer:
本题限定使用连接或外连接。五小题的处理分别是：

1. 连接参与者与资格，按参与者分组，筛选资格数大于2，再按姓、名排序。原数据对应PARTICIPANT_02 SAMPLE和PARTICIPANT_07 SAMPLE。
2. 从工作坊出发LEFT JOIN资格要求，保留右侧没有匹配记录的工作坊。原数据对应工作坊6。
3. 从参与者出发LEFT JOIN报名记录，保留未报名的人。统计右侧实际存在的workshopNo，不用COUNT(*)。原数据中参与者11的次数是0。题目没有排除取消报名，这里也不排除。
4. 从工作坊出发LEFT JOIN培训师分配，统计右侧trainerNo。没有培训师的工作坊8得到0。
5. 从培训师出发LEFT JOIN分配表，保留未匹配者。原数据对应培训师8。


```sql
-- (1)
SELECT CONCAT(P.fname, ' ', P.lname) AS fullName, P.phone
FROM Participant AS P
JOIN Qualification AS Q ON Q.participantNo = P.participantNo
GROUP BY P.participantNo, P.fname, P.lname, P.phone
HAVING COUNT(Q.qname) > 2
ORDER BY P.lname ASC, P.fname ASC;

-- (2)
SELECT W.workshopNo, W.title, W.category
FROM Workshop AS W
LEFT JOIN Requirement AS R ON R.workshopNo = W.workshopNo
WHERE R.workshopNo IS NULL;

-- (3)
SELECT P.participantNo, CONCAT(P.fname, ' ', P.lname) AS fullName,
       COUNT(E.workshopNo) AS totalEnrolments
FROM Participant AS P
LEFT JOIN Enrolment AS E ON E.participantNo = P.participantNo
GROUP BY P.participantNo, P.fname, P.lname
ORDER BY totalEnrolments ASC;

-- (4)
SELECT W.workshopNo, W.title, COUNT(WT.trainerNo) AS totalTrainers
FROM Workshop AS W
LEFT JOIN WorkshopTrainer AS WT ON WT.workshopNo = W.workshopNo
GROUP BY W.workshopNo, W.title
ORDER BY totalTrainers ASC;

-- (5)
SELECT T.trainerNo, CONCAT(T.fname, ' ', T.lname) AS fullName
FROM Trainer AS T
LEFT JOIN WorkshopTrainer AS WT ON WT.trainerNo = T.trainerNo
WHERE WT.trainerNo IS NULL;
```

parts.goal: 用JOIN查询超过2项资格者的姓名和电话
steps: Participant JOIN Qualification使用participantNo。
按参与者编号及输出姓名电话字段分组，再HAVING COUNT(Q.qname)>2。
ORDER BY lname,fname，确保同名不同参与者不被错误合并。
parts.check: 原数据PARTICIPANT_02和PARTICIPANT_07符合。

```sql
FROM Participant AS P
JOIN Qualification AS Q ON Q.participantNo = P.participantNo
GROUP BY P.participantNo, P.fname, P.lname, P.phone
HAVING COUNT(Q.qname) > 2
ORDER BY P.lname ASC, P.fname ASC;
```

steps: 以Workshop为左表LEFT JOIN Requirement。
连接条件workshopNo相等。
WHERE R.workshopNo IS NULL表示整条右侧不存在；选择W的编号、标题、类别。
parts.check: 原数据工作坊6符合。
parts.pitfall: 不要检查一个本来允许NULL的非键字段来判断右侧是否存在。

```sql

LEFT JOIN Requirement AS R ON R.workshopNo = W.workshopNo
```

steps: Participant LEFT JOIN Enrolment，保留完整参与者集合。
按参与者分组，COUNT(E.workshopNo)只计实际匹配的报名。
ORDER BY totalEnrolments ASC。题面没有要求排除CANCELLED，因此计入这些报名记录。

steps: Workshop LEFT JOIN WorkshopTrainer，不连接Enrolment。
按工作坊分组，COUNT(WT.trainerNo)计真实分配行。
按总数升序排列，未分配培训师的工作坊8为0。

questions.title: Assignment 4 — Task 1
questions.topic: 嵌套查询与关联嵌套查询
questions.sourceNote: Assignment 4.pdf pp3,5–6,8,10; original dbcreate.sql and dbload.sql
questions.question:
Implement SQL nested query statements for questions (1), (2) and (3). 

(1) Find the workshop number, title and fee of every workshop whose fee is higher than  the average fee of all workshops. 

(2) Find the participant number and full name of participants who have completed at least  one TECHNOLOGY workshop and at least one BUSINESS workshop. Cancelled  enrolments must not contribute to either condition. 

(3) Find the trainer number and full name of trainers assigned to at least two workshops.  Count workshop assignments, not enrolments.    Implement SQL correlated nested query statements for questions (4) and 

(5). 

(4) Find the participant number, full name, qualification name and qualification level of  participants whose level is the highest recorded for that qualification name. Order by  qualification name, then participant number. 

(5) Find the participant number and full name of participants who have completed at least  one workshop with a current fee of 200.00 or more. Ignore cancelled enrolments.
questions.answer:
(1) 先用子查询算全部工作坊的平均费用，外层筛选费用高于该平均值的工作坊。原数据对应1、2、5、7。

(2) 两个条件必须同时满足：至少完成一门技术类工作坊，并至少完成一门商务类工作坊。因此分别找出满足两类条件的参与者，再同时用IN判断。两部分都只计COMPLETED。原数据对应参与者1、4、9。

(3) 统计WorkshopTrainer中的培训师分配次数，保留至少两次者。不能改数Enrolment的报名人数。原数据对应培训师1、7。

(4) 对当前Qualification行，用相同qname的最大qlevel作比较。子查询引用外层qname，属于correlated subquery。达到相同最高等级的多个人都保留；不是找整张表的一个最高值。

(5) 对当前参与者，检查是否存在一条已完成的报名，其工作坊现在的费用至少200。这里使用当前Workshop.fee，不假设保存了历史支付费用。原数据对应参与者1、4、7、9。

前一代码块对应(1)–(3)，后一代码块对应(4)–(5)。


```sql
-- (1)
SELECT workshopNo, title, fee
FROM Workshop
WHERE fee > (SELECT AVG(fee) FROM Workshop);

-- (2)
SELECT P.participantNo, CONCAT(P.fname, ' ', P.lname) AS fullName
FROM Participant AS P
WHERE P.participantNo IN (
    SELECT E.participantNo
    FROM Enrolment AS E
    WHERE E.status = 'COMPLETED'
      AND E.workshopNo IN (
          SELECT workshopNo FROM Workshop WHERE category = 'TECHNOLOGY'
      )
)
AND P.participantNo IN (
    SELECT E.participantNo
    FROM Enrolment AS E
    WHERE E.status = 'COMPLETED'
      AND E.workshopNo IN (
          SELECT workshopNo FROM Workshop WHERE category = 'BUSINESS'
      )
);

-- (3)
SELECT T.trainerNo, CONCAT(T.fname, ' ', T.lname) AS fullName
FROM Trainer AS T
WHERE T.trainerNo IN (
    SELECT WT.trainerNo
    FROM WorkshopTrainer AS WT
    GROUP BY WT.trainerNo
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
);
```

```sql
-- (4)
SELECT P.participantNo, CONCAT(P.fname, ' ', P.lname) AS fullName,
       Q.qname, Q.qlevel
FROM Participant AS P
JOIN Qualification AS Q ON Q.participantNo = P.participantNo
WHERE Q.qlevel = (
    SELECT MAX(Q2.qlevel)
    FROM Qualification AS Q2
    WHERE Q2.qname = Q.qname
)
ORDER BY Q.qname, P.participantNo;

-- (5)
SELECT P.participantNo, CONCAT(P.fname, ' ', P.lname) AS fullName
FROM Participant AS P
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Enrolment AS E
    JOIN Workshop AS W ON W.workshopNo = E.workshopNo
    WHERE E.participantNo = P.participantNo
      AND E.status = 'COMPLETED'
      AND W.fee >= 200.00
);
```

parts.goal: 用nested query比较全体平均费用
steps: 内层SELECT AVG(fee) FROM Workshop只产生一个数。
外层逐工作坊比较fee>这个平均值；大于不是大于等于。
取workshopNo,title,fee；原数据平均168.75，符合1、2、5、7。

parts.pitfall: 把平均按category分组会改变比较基准。
parts.code:
```sql
SELECT workshopNo, title, fee
FROM Workshop
WHERE fee > (SELECT AVG(fee) FROM Workshop);
```

parts.goal: 同时满足技术类和商务类已完成条件
steps: 内层先各找TECHNOLOGY、BUSINESS工作坊集合。

questions.question:
(1) Implement SELECT statements in a WITH clause for the query below.    Find the participant number, full name and email of all  participants who have enrolled in a workshop taught by at  least one trainer whose organisation is 'UOW'. Include  enrolments regardless of their status. Use at least two named  common table expressions.    You must implement at least 2 subqueries in the WITH clause for this question. 

(2) Use relational views to implement the questions below.    Find the workshop number, title and category of all workshops  in which PARTICIPANT_02 SAMPLE has enrolled. Display the result, then  drop the views in dependency order.    You must create at least 2 views to implement the query above. 

(3) Implement the questions below by using the advanced DDL and other required  statements.    Use one CREATE TABLE ... AS SELECT statement to create and  populate ParticipantQualifications with the participant  number, full name, email and total number of qualifications  possessed by each participant, including participants with no  qualifications. Name the columns participantNo, fullName,  email and totalQualifications. Then define participantNo as  both the primary key and a foreign key referencing  Participant(participantNo). Display all rows and finally drop 

ParticipantQualifications. 

(4) Implement the questions below by using the advanced DML statements.    Increase capacity by 10 places for each workshop assigned to  at least two trainers. Use WorkshopTrainer to identify the  workshops rather than hard-coded numbers. Display the workshop  number, title and new capacity of the affected workshops. 

(5) Implement the questions below by using the advanced DML statements.  Remove BUSINESS workshops whose current fee is less than 
150.00.   Note that you must remove the information from the child tables (which contain  foreign key references to the parent table), then remove the information from the  parent table (which is referenced by the child tables).
questions.answer:
### (1) 两个有名称的common table expression (CTE)

第一个CTE找出至少有一位UOW培训师的工作坊；第二个CTE找出报名过这些工作坊的参与者。最后读取这些人的编号、全名和邮箱。按题目要求，报名状态不限，包含取消报名。原数据对应1、2、4、7、8、12。

```sql
WITH UOWWorkshops AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT WT.workshopNo
    FROM WorkshopTrainer AS WT
    JOIN Trainer AS T ON T.trainerNo = WT.trainerNo
    WHERE T.organisation = 'UOW'
),
EligibleParticipants AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT E.participantNo
    FROM Enrolment AS E
    JOIN UOWWorkshops AS U ON U.workshopNo = E.workshopNo
)
SELECT P.participantNo, CONCAT(P.fname, ' ', P.lname) AS fullName, P.email
FROM Participant AS P
JOIN EligibleParticipants AS EP ON EP.participantNo = P.participantNo;
```

### (2) 两个视图以及删除顺序

第一个视图找出PARTICIPANT_02 SAMPLE报名的工作坊编号；第二个视图引用第一个，读取工作坊详情。显示结果后，先删依赖别人的TargetWorkshops，再删被依赖的TargetEnrolments。原数据为工作坊1和6。

```sql
CREATE VIEW TargetEnrolments AS
SELECT E.workshopNo
FROM Enrolment AS E
JOIN Participant AS P ON P.participantNo = E.participantNo
WHERE P.fname = 'PARTICIPANT_02' AND P.lname = 'SAMPLE';

CREATE VIEW TargetWorkshops AS
SELECT DISTINCT W.workshopNo, W.title, W.category
FROM Workshop AS W
JOIN TargetEnrolments AS L ON L.workshopNo = W.workshopNo;

SELECT workshopNo, title, category FROM TargetWorkshops;

DROP VIEW TargetWorkshops;
DROP VIEW TargetEnrolments;
```

### (3) 创建统计表，再追加键约束

LEFT JOIN保留没有资格的参与者，用COUNT(Q.qname)得到0。CREATE TABLE ... AS SELECT不会自动复制源表的primary key和foreign key，所以再用ALTER TABLE定义。按题面列出全部行后删除表。

```sql
CREATE TABLE ParticipantQualifications AS
SELECT P.participantNo,
       CONCAT(P.fname, ' ', P.lname) AS fullName,
       P.email,
       COUNT(Q.qname) AS totalQualifications
FROM Participant AS P
LEFT JOIN Qualification AS Q ON Q.participantNo = P.participantNo
GROUP BY P.participantNo, P.fname, P.lname, P.email;

ALTER TABLE ParticipantQualifications
    ADD CONSTRAINT pq_pkey PRIMARY KEY (participantNo),
    ADD CONSTRAINT pq_fkey FOREIGN KEY (participantNo)
        REFERENCES Participant(participantNo);

SELECT participantNo, fullName, email, totalQualifications
FROM ParticipantQualifications;

DROP TABLE ParticipantQualifications;
```

### (4) 按培训师人数增加容量

先从WorkshopTrainer中按工作坊分组，找出分配至少两位培训师的工作坊；以此更新capacity，再用同一条件显示结果。原数据中工作坊3从50变60，工作坊7从35变45。题目是加10个名额，不是提高10%，也不是修改费用。

```sql
UPDATE Workshop
SET capacity = capacity + 10
WHERE workshopNo IN (
    SELECT workshopNo
    FROM WorkshopTrainer
    GROUP BY workshopNo
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
);

SELECT W.workshopNo, W.title, W.capacity
FROM Workshop AS W
WHERE W.workshopNo IN (
    SELECT workshopNo
    FROM WorkshopTrainer
    GROUP BY workshopNo
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
);
```

### (5) 删除符合条件的商务类工作坊

删除条件必须同时满足category为BUSINESS、fee小于150。先删Enrolment、Requirement、WorkshopTrainer中的相关行，再删Workshop。原数据目标为工作坊4和8。保留参与者和培训师本身，也不关闭foreign key。

```sql
DELETE FROM Enrolment
WHERE workshopNo IN (
    SELECT workshopNo FROM Workshop
    WHERE category = 'BUSINESS' AND fee < 150.00
);

DELETE FROM Requirement
WHERE workshopNo IN (
    SELECT workshopNo FROM Workshop
    WHERE category = 'BUSINESS' AND fee < 150.00
);

DELETE FROM WorkshopTrainer
WHERE workshopNo IN (
    SELECT workshopNo FROM Workshop
    WHERE category = 'BUSINESS' AND fee < 150.00
);

DELETE FROM Workshop
WHERE category = 'BUSINESS' AND fee < 150.00;
```
